2610.12176.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of a model on non-verifiable tasks, such as open-ended research, faces a supervision bottleneck when its outputs exceed what even human experts can reliably assess, leaving the model itself (optimizee) as the best available optimizer and evaluator. However, a single model instance struggles to critique and improve its own complex reasoning under this homogeneous loop. To address this, we propose Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS), an RSI method that alternates between evolutionary workflow optimization and supervised fine-tuning on self-generated trajectories. Guided by early findings that multi-agent topologies excel at complex reasoning, MASS prompts a single base model to iteratively propose, execute, and self-evaluate multi-agent workflows. Through an evolutionary search constrained by structural guardrails, the model optimizes these computational-graph-like orchestrations, discovering the most effective distinct roles and information routing for a given task. Over two MASS cycles with Qwen3.6-27B, the model achieves 1.2-1.6x higher performance per output tokens on four open-ended public benchmarks. Because the improved model subsequently acts as a better optimizer and evaluator, this alternating framework enables a continuous, recursive bootstrapping of the model's capabilities. Moreover, multi-agent traces are also more training-efficient: a student trained on them outperforms a single-agent student trained on 1.4x more training tokens. These findings suggest that jointly learning orchestration and bounded subagent execution from multi-agent trajectories can provide an effective signal for RSI.
2610.12176.mechanism_zh: 在结构约束下搜索多 Agent 角色和信息流，再用自生成轨迹监督微调；更新后的同一模型继续担任优化器和评估器。
2610.12176.result_zh: Qwen3.6-27B 两轮 MASS 后，四个开放式基准的单位输出 token 表现为原来的 1.2–1.6 倍。
2610.12176.boundary_zh: 同源自评可能共享盲点；两轮结果不能外推为无限持续改进。
2610.12176.abstract_zh: 模型在开放式研究等不可验证任务上的递归自我改进（RSI）面临监督瓶颈：当输出超出人类专家能够可靠评估的范围时，模型自身（被优化者）也成为最佳可用的优化器和评估器。然而，单个模型实例很难在这一同质闭环中批评并改进自身的复杂推理。为此，我们提出多智能体自监督（MASS），在进化式工作流优化与基于自生成轨迹的监督微调之间交替进行。受到多智能体拓扑擅长复杂推理的早期发现启发，MASS 提示同一个基础模型反复提出、执行和自评多智能体工作流。在结构性约束下进行进化搜索，模型优化类似计算图的组织方式，为任务发现最有效的不同角色及信息路由。使用 Qwen3.6-27B 进行两个 MASS 周期后，模型在四个开放式公开基准上的单位输出 token 性能提高至原来的 1.2–1.6 倍。改进后的模型又充当更好的优化器和评估器，使这一交替框架能够递归地自举模型能力。多智能体轨迹的训练效率也更高：基于此类轨迹训练的学生超过了使用 1.4 倍训练 token 的单智能体学生。这些发现表明，从多智能体轨迹中联合学习组织方式和有界子智能体执行，可以为 RSI 提供有效信号。
2610.12176.title: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision
2610.12176.authors: Hyunin Lee, Jinglue Xu, Jeffrey Seely, Donghyun Lee, Somayeh Sojoudi, Matei Zaharia, Yujin Tang

2610.11794.abstract_en: Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3, building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation, reflection, rule revision, compilation, and verification, the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0, and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins 21:0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.
2610.11794.update_target: 外部规则册与可执行世界模型；基础模型冻结
2610.11794.mechanism_zh: 观察、反思、修正规则、编译和验证循环；代码须通过规则忠实性判断，并逐格精确重放已观测转移。
2610.11794.result_zh: 单模型 Agent 完成 ARC-AGI-3 的 25 个公开游戏全部关卡，平均 RHAE 为 100.0，动作数为人类的 44%；Pong 三个不同开局均为 21:0。
2610.11794.boundary_zh: 公开游戏及三个 Pong 回合的证据不等于未见环境的普遍迁移；规则一致性仍含 LLM 判断。
2610.11794.abstract_zh: 在陌生环境中学习行动，要求智能体推断世界如何运作，并随新证据修正认识。但有限观察可能支持多个世界模型：它们都解释过去交互，却对未见状态预测不同。我们提出 Memento 3，在 Memento 系列基础上，让冻结的 LLM 智能体通过外部记忆持续学习显式世界模型。智能体以自然语言规则册作为持久语义记忆，记录可修正的环境动力学假设，并让未知部分保持未规定状态。它把规则册编译为可执行代码，用于预测和规划。通过观察、反思、规则修订、编译与验证的持续循环，智能体利用预测误差同时改进规则册及其代码。只有当 LLM 判断新代码忠实于规则册，而且逐格精确重放能够复现观测转移时，更新才被接纳。我们将其研究为通向递归自我改进（RSI）的模型式路径：智能体自主探索环境、修正世界模型，并用经过验证的更新指导后续交互与学习，而底层 LLM 保持固定。种群扩展同时维护多个世界模型，共享交互证据，并利用各模型预测引导探索。在 ARC-AGI-3 上，单模型智能体通过全部 25 个公开游戏的所有关卡，平均相对人类动作效率（RHAE）为 100.0，使用人类动作数的 44%。在 Atari Pong 案例中，学得的反馈控制器在三个不同开局的评估回合中均以 21:0 获胜，且无需进一步调用 LLM。
2610.11794.title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks
2610.11794.authors: Haoyu Zhao, Zhengxu Yu, Zhiyuan He, Meng Fang, Rasul Tutunov, Haitham Bou-Ammar, Weilin Luo, Jun Wang

2610.11613.abstract_en: An agent can complete a task without improving how it works. Turning task experience into reusable capability requires connecting the changed component to its evaluation and subsequent use. We present AgentEvolver, a system for developing capabilities during task execution while keeping the foundation model fixed. Eight entity families expose reusable operations, methods, agents, control flow, interfaces, and supporting state to revision through a common versioned lifecycle. A shared Runtime coordinates ongoing work, while persistent planning and recoverable context preserve task direction and supporting evidence. We evaluate task outcomes on SWE-bench Pro Public and examine capability changes in six application cases. The team reports an 82.08\% resolution rate with evolution, exceeding its reported baseline without evolution. The cases show retained capabilities entering later website, game, and research work, while also documenting incomplete objectives and an unsuccessful strategy. These findings distinguish improvement in a reusable component from success on the final task. AgentEvolver provides a concrete basis for studying capability accumulation through execution; independent-task transfer and total development cost remain open questions.
2610.11613.update_target: 八类版本化可复用组件；基础模型冻结
2610.11613.mechanism_zh: 把组件修改、对应评估和后续使用接入共同生命周期；共享 Runtime、持久规划和可恢复上下文支撑任务执行。
2610.11613.result_zh: 作者报告 SWE-bench Pro Public 解决率 82.08%，并给出六个应用案例，包含未完成目标和失败策略。
2610.11613.boundary_zh: 论文明确承认跨独立任务迁移与总开发成本仍待解决；组件改进和最终任务成功应分别统计。
2610.11613.abstract_zh: 智能体可以完成任务，却没有改善自己的工作方式。要把任务经验转化为可复用能力，必须把发生变化的组件与其评估及后续使用连接起来。我们提出 AgentEvolver，在保持基础模型固定的同时于任务执行中发展能力。八类实体通过统一的版本化生命周期，使可复用操作、方法、智能体、控制流、接口及支持状态能够被修订。共享 Runtime 协调正在进行的工作，持久规划和可恢复上下文保留任务方向及支撑证据。我们在 SWE-bench Pro Public 上评估任务结果，并在六个应用案例中检查能力变化。团队报告启用进化时的解决率为 82.08%，高于其报告的未启用进化基线。案例展示保留下来的能力如何进入后续网站、游戏和研究工作，也记录了未完成的目标及一种失败策略。这些发现区分了可复用组件的改进与最终任务的成功。AgentEvolver 为研究执行过程中的能力积累提供了具体基础；跨独立任务迁移及总开发成本仍是开放问题。
2610.11613.title: AgentEvolver: System-Wide Self-Evolution Through Task Execution
2610.11613.authors: Wentao Zhang, Fuchao Yang, Yilei Zhao, Xinrun Wang, Bo An

2610.11299.abstract_en: Voice agents are converging on a collaboration pattern: a full-duplex interaction model stays on the live channel as the entry to the conversation, while search, reasoning, and coding are handled through asynchronous delegation. A duplex model supports continuous listening and speaking, but complex reasoning and tool use may exceed its capabilities. A coding agent can plan and execute extended tasks, but its sequential interface is a poor fit for live conversation. Combining them requires a harness that coordinates task acceptance, progress, cancellation, replacement, and result delivery while keeping the conversation responsive. Existing harnesses often rely on coupled heuristics, making them difficult to improve systematically from evidence. We present DuplexAgent, a full-duplex collaboration system whose harness expresses this workflow as six editable modules, and Duplex-Harness-RSI, a closed loop that revises them from interaction traces. A simulator automatically generates timed test conversations, runs the system, and produces failure traces that identify the collaboration modules requiring repair. Reasoning LLMs and coding agents in the delegation pool also serve the improvement loop: the Exam Planner selects the next tests from observed weaknesses and the repair archive, and the Harness Editor proposes targeted module changes. The capabilities that serve the user thus also improve the system's coordination. Experiments on intelligence, agentic, and duplex benchmarks show that DuplexAgent combines continuous interaction with difficult reasoning and complex task execution, achieving stronger spoken-knowledge and executable-tool scores than the compared delegated systems while maintaining strong interruption response. A harness ablation further shows that this modular, verifiable loop outperforms the initial harness and repeated editing that lacks its diagnosis and repair archive.
2610.11299.update_target: 全双工语音 Agent 的六个协作模块
2610.11299.mechanism_zh: 模拟器生成带时间信息的测试对话并定位失败；Exam Planner 选择测试，Harness Editor 结合修复档案修改模块。
2610.11299.result_zh: 在智能、Agent 和双工基准上比较知识、工具执行及中断响应；模块化闭环优于初始框架和缺少诊断档案的反复编辑。
2610.11299.boundary_zh: 主要证据是可测试协作框架的改进，不应据此声称语音基础模型权重进化。
2610.11299.abstract_zh: 语音智能体正在形成一种协作模式：全双工交互模型持续留在实时通道中作为对话入口，而搜索、推理和编程通过异步委派完成。双工模型支持持续聆听和说话，但复杂推理及工具使用可能超出其能力；编程智能体能够规划并执行长任务，但顺序式接口不适合实时对话。结合二者，需要运行框架协调任务接收、进度、取消、替换和结果交付，同时保持对话响应。现有框架往往依赖相互耦合的启发式规则，难以根据证据系统改进。我们提出 DuplexAgent，将这一工作流表示为六个可编辑模块，并提出依据交互轨迹修订模块的闭环 Duplex-Harness-RSI。模拟器自动生成带时间信息的测试对话、运行系统，并输出定位待修复协作模块的失败轨迹。委派池中的推理 LLM 和编程智能体也服务于改进循环：Exam Planner 根据观察到的弱点及修复档案选择下一批测试，Harness Editor 提出针对性的模块修改。因此，为用户服务的能力也用于改进系统协调。智能、Agent 和双工基准实验表明，DuplexAgent 将持续交互与困难推理、复杂任务执行相结合，相比所比较的委派系统取得更强的口语知识及可执行工具得分，同时保持较强的中断响应。框架消融还表明，这一模块化、可验证闭环优于初始框架，以及缺少诊断和修复档案的反复编辑。
2610.11299.title: DuplexAgent-RSI: Recursive Harness Improvement for Full-Duplex Voice Agent Collaboration
2610.11299.authors: Yingda Shen, Yuxiang Wang, Kunyu Feng, Qinke Ni, Jiaqi Li, Minghao Hsu, Junan Zhang, Dekun Chen, Yutong Bian, Zhizheng Wu

2610.12424.abstract_en: A generalist robot should not only perform diverse tasks but also improve through experience, turning what it learns during execution into capabilities that later tasks can reuse. Robot agents that act through code can already repair programs from execution feedback, yet it remains a central challenge to organize this experience around the task structure that gives it meaning, so that each repair is attributed to the responsible capability, supported by execution evidence, and validated before it is reused. We introduce RoboRSI, a robot self-improvement system built on Top-Down Skill Refinement (TSR). TSR decomposes tasks into compound, atomic, and base skills with scoped responsibilities and explicit input--output contracts, attributes each execution outcome to the responsible branch, and confines revision to that branch. Building upon this structure, a Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer coordinate planning, execution, diagnosis, and the validated release of new skills, while people steer the process through objectives and corrections; stable skill sequences are further consolidated into reusable compound skills. On a mobile manipulator, RoboRSI develops multi-object household cleanup over 104 rounds. In simulation, it achieves the highest success rate on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.7 to 11.0 percentage points.
2610.12424.update_target: 机器人的复合、原子与基础技能代码
2610.12424.mechanism_zh: TSR 根据任务结构定位责任分支，限定修订范围并验证后发布；人通过目标和纠正引导，稳定序列再固化为复合技能。
2610.12424.result_zh: 移动操作机器人经历 104 轮多物体家务清理开发；四组模拟基准较最强比较基线高 2.7–11.0 个百分点。
2610.12424.boundary_zh: 系统含人类目标和纠正，不能写为完全无人干预；真实开发轮次与模拟基准提升是不同证据。
2610.12424.abstract_zh: 通用机器人不仅应能执行多种任务，还应通过经验改进，将执行中学到的内容转化为后续任务可复用的能力。通过代码行动的机器人智能体已经能利用执行反馈修复程序，但如何按照赋予经验意义的任务结构组织这些经验仍是核心挑战：每次修复都应归因到负责的能力，有执行证据支撑，并在复用前得到验证。我们提出 RoboRSI，一个基于自顶向下技能细化（TSR）的机器人自改进系统。TSR 将任务分解为具有限定职责和明确输入输出契约的复合、原子及基础技能，把每次执行结果归因到负责的分支，并将修订限定在该分支。基于此结构，Manager、Planner、Engineer 和 Reviewer 协调规划、执行、诊断及新技能的验证发布；人通过目标与纠正引导过程，稳定的技能序列则进一步固化为可复用复合技能。在移动操作机器人上，RoboRSI 通过 104 轮开发多物体家务清理能力。在模拟中，它在 LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO、LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboTwin 上取得最高成功率，比最强基线高 2.7–11.0 个百分点。
2610.12424.title: RoboRSI: Stable, efficient, and reusable robot self-evolution in complex real-world environments
2610.12424.authors: Zimo Wen, Yijin Chen, Yuxuan Cao, Wendi Chen, Yanwen Zou, Wenye Yu, Fuhang Kuang, Han Xue, Jun Lv, Chuan Wen, Cewu Lu

2610.12369.abstract_en: Most robot policies keep a model in the control loop: a VLA maps observations to actions, and an Agent Harness, such as Agent-as-Policy or Harness VLA queries a VLM for decision making at run time. We propose a different view: the embodied world is an Embodied Turing Machine, whose tape is the robot and environment state and rules are the policy. If this state can be represented accurately, the decision making can be written entirely in code. We therefore propose Code-Only-as-Policy (COAP): code measures and tracks the robot, environment, and task state from camera images and proprioception, and makes every decision from it. The same code applies across episodes, and different tasks share one library without a VLM or VLA in the loop. Compared with VLAs and Agent Harnesses, we analyze three advantages of COAP: (i) Explicit State: the state can be stored in code; (ii) Execution: code makes decision making controllable, recovers from failures flexibly, and runs fast and cheaply online; (iii) Extensibility: new tasks reuse, inherit, or extend the shared library, so capabilities can accumulate over tasks. These advantages make COAP a suitable medium for recursive self-improvement (RSI): coding agents develop the library in a closed loop, and each change is explicit and controllable. On RoboDojo's 42 bimanual tasks, the resulting library reaches a success rate of 70.24% without a model at test time. The upper bound of COAP lies in how accurately the state is represented for decision making and how robust the code logic is. We thus propose COAP as a new paradigm for embodied tasks; since it applies across episodes, it can also serve as an efficient data engine for VLAs and Agent Harnesses.
2610.12369.update_target: 跨回合共享的状态化机器人代码库
2610.12369.mechanism_zh: Code-Only-as-Policy 从相机与本体感觉跟踪状态，以代码决策；编程 Agent 闭环开发可复用、可继承的库。
2610.12369.result_zh: 在 RoboDojo 的 42 个双臂任务上，测试时无模型的代码库成功率为 70.24%。
2610.12369.boundary_zh: 性能依赖状态表示准确性与代码鲁棒性；测试时不调用模型不意味着开发过程不依赖模型。
2610.12369.abstract_zh: 多数机器人策略让模型处于控制闭环：VLA 将观察映射为动作，Agent-as-Policy 或 Harness VLA 等运行框架在执行时查询 VLM 作决策。我们提出另一种观点：具身世界是一台具身图灵机，其纸带是机器人和环境状态，规则是策略。如果能准确表示这些状态，决策就可以完全写成代码。因此，我们提出 Code-Only-as-Policy（COAP）：代码从相机图像和本体感觉测量并跟踪机器人、环境及任务状态，所有决策均以此为依据。同一份代码跨回合使用，不同任务共享一个库，闭环内不需要 VLM 或 VLA。相对于 VLA 与 Agent 运行框架，我们分析了三项优势：（i）显式状态：状态可存储于代码中；（ii）执行：代码使决策可控、能够灵活恢复失败，并且在线运行快速、廉价；（iii）可扩展性：新任务复用、继承或扩展共享库，使能力跨任务积累。这些优势使 COAP 成为递归自我改进（RSI）的合适载体：编程智能体以闭环开发该库，每次修改都显式且可控。在 RoboDojo 的 42 个双臂任务中，所得代码库在测试时无模型的情况下达到 70.24% 成功率。COAP 的上限取决于用于决策的状态表示有多准确，以及代码逻辑有多稳健。因此，我们将 COAP 提议为具身任务的新范式；由于它可跨回合使用，也能成为 VLA 和 Agent 运行框架的高效数据引擎。
2610.12369.title: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement
2610.12369.authors: Kairui Hu, Siyuan Hu, Fangzhou Hong, Zhaoxi Chen, Ziwei Liu
2610.12369.categories: Robotics (cs.RO); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

2610.11344.abstract_en: Physics-based models connect scientific explanation with quantitative prediction. Constructing them requires selecting physical processes, defining states and governing equations, specifying couplings, and identifying parameters from experiments. Existing AI systems remain limited in making these model structure decisions autonomously. We introduce EvoSim, a self-evolving AI scientist for physical modeling. It uses experimental discrepancies to drive mechanism and equation revisions and held-out experimental data to test physical plausibility. Exploration traces make updates to knowledge, skills, and multi-agent orchestration. This co-evolution improves physics-based models and EvoSim's ability to select mechanisms, diagnose failures, and coordinate research. We evaluate EvoSim on two industrial battery modeling tasks. It predicts lithium-metal-plating onset from 25 to 45 degrees Celsius and 2 C to 6 C with a mean absolute error of 1.79% in state of charge. Dynamic voltage prediction under vehicle driving conditions achieves a root mean square error of 7.62 mV, surpassing the reported accuracy of models developed by human experts. Self-evolution reduces model and physics errors by approximately 36% relative to baseline, demonstrating improved scientific modeling capability. EvoSim turns experimental observations into validated models and cumulative research expertise.
2610.11344.update_target: 科学模型方程及科研系统的知识、技能和组织方式
2610.11344.mechanism_zh: 以实验偏差驱动物理机制和方程修改，用留出实验数据检验物理合理性；探索轨迹同时更新研究能力。
2610.11344.result_zh: 两项工业电池任务：析锂起始 SOC 平均绝对误差 1.79%，动态电压 RMSE 为 7.62 mV；自进化使模型和物理误差较基线下降约 36%。
2610.11344.boundary_zh: 两类电池建模任务不能证明通用自动科研能力；应分别比较科学模型更新与研究系统更新的贡献。
2610.11344.abstract_zh: 基于物理的模型将科学解释与定量预测连接起来。构建这类模型需要选择物理过程、定义状态和控制方程、规定耦合关系，并通过实验辨识参数。现有 AI 系统在自主作出这些模型结构决策方面仍有局限。我们提出 EvoSim，一个面向物理建模的自进化 AI 科学家。它利用实验偏差驱动物理机制与方程的修订，并利用留出实验数据检验物理合理性。探索轨迹促成知识、技能及多智能体组织方式的更新。这种共同进化既改进物理模型，也提升 EvoSim 选择机制、诊断失败和协调研究的能力。我们在两项工业电池建模任务上评估 EvoSim。在 25–45 摄氏度、2 C–6 C 条件下，它预测金属锂析出起始时刻的荷电状态，平均绝对误差为 1.79%。在车辆行驶工况下，动态电压预测的均方根误差为 7.62 mV，超过论文所报告的人类专家模型准确性。相对基线，自进化使模型误差和物理误差下降约 36%，表明科学建模能力得到改进。EvoSim 将实验观察转化为经过验证的模型及不断积累的研究经验。
2610.11344.title: EvoSim: Learning to Model, Modeling to Learn
2610.11344.authors: Yun-Wei Song, Jinkai Tao, Jun-Dong Zhang, Rui Zhang, Yi-Min Wu, Qiang Zhang
2610.11344.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computational Engineering, Finance, and Science (cs.CE)

2610.11458.abstract_en: AI research progress can be viewed as the interaction between two processes: benchmark creation and method discovery. Historically, both were driven by human intelligence. However, recent advances in AI have accelerated automated method discovery, while automated benchmark creation has received comparatively less attention. To enable self-advancing systems, we propose Generative Adversarial Loop (GAL), a generator-discriminator framework alternating between two agentic searches: (1) a discriminator that generates adversarial data to expose weaknesses in current systems, and (2) a generator that discovers algorithms to overcome them. We apply this framework to approximation algorithms for efficient inference. Unlike existing auto research systems, which primarily focus on algorithm discovery, GAL introduces a discriminator agent that automates goalpost setting by continually searching for weaknesses in the current algorithm. We demonstrate adversarial data generation across four tasks: KV compression, sparse video generation, sparse attention, and context extension, where the discriminator identifies weaknesses in state of the art techniques. We further show that GAL enables autonomous improvement, with newly discovered algorithms improving not only on adversarially generated data, but also on established benchmarks. Specifically, GAL improves CompactorPress on KV compression with Qwen3-4B at 4x, raising performance on the discriminator dataset from 0.35 to 0.97, while also outperforming RULER-HARD (+0.77 pts). For context extension, GAL boosts Dual Chunk Attention from 0.20 to 0.90 on the discriminator dataset, while yielding gains on standard benchmarks(ScienceFiction (+6 pts) and PG19 32K (-0.33 PPL)). GAL thus provides a path toward autonomous goalpost setting and algorithmic improvement, where AI systems continually discover their own weaknesses and develop methods to overcome them.
2610.11458.update_target: 对抗基准与算法；自动科研目标共同演化
2610.11458.mechanism_zh: 判别器搜索现有算法的弱点并生成对抗数据，生成器发现解决这些弱点的算法；交替更新二者。
2610.11458.result_zh: 覆盖 KV 压缩、稀疏视频生成、稀疏注意力和上下文扩展；标准基准也有改善，包括 RULER-HARD +0.77 点与 ScienceFiction +6 点。
2610.11458.boundary_zh: 必须同时看固定外部基准及自生成对抗集，避免把移动评测分布上的进步当作普遍改进。
2610.11458.abstract_zh: AI 研究进展可以看作两个过程的相互作用：基准创建与方法发现。历史上二者都由人类智能推动。近期 AI 进展加速了自动方法发现，但自动基准创建受到的关注相对较少。为实现能够自行推进的系统，我们提出生成对抗循环（GAL），在两种智能体搜索之间交替：（1）判别器生成对抗数据，暴露当前系统的弱点；（2）生成器发现克服这些弱点的算法。我们将该框架应用于高效推理的近似算法。与主要关注算法发现的现有自动研究系统不同，GAL 引入判别器智能体，通过持续寻找当前算法的弱点，自动设定新的改进目标。我们在 KV 压缩、稀疏视频生成、稀疏注意力和上下文扩展四项任务上展示对抗数据生成，判别器能够识别先进技术的弱点。我们进一步表明，GAL 能够实现自主改进：新发现算法不仅在对抗生成数据上进步，也在既有基准上进步。具体而言，在 Qwen3-4B 的 4 倍 KV 压缩中，GAL 改进 CompactorPress，使判别器数据集上的表现从 0.35 提高到 0.97，并在 RULER-HARD 上提高 0.77 点。在上下文扩展中，GAL 将 Dual Chunk Attention 在判别器数据集上的表现从 0.20 提高到 0.90，同时改善标准基准表现：ScienceFiction 提高 6 点，PG19 32K 的困惑度降低 0.33。GAL 因此提供了一条自主设定目标和改进算法的路径，让 AI 系统持续发现自身弱点并开发克服弱点的方法。
2610.11458.title: Generative Adversarial Loops
2610.11458.authors: Kislay Aditya Oj, Nidhi Jain, Sri Surya Varma Datla, Priyanka Jayaswal, Kumar Krishna Agrawal, Aditya Desai
2610.11458.affiliation: IIT Bombay / UC Berkeley / Independent researchers

2610.12233.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement, the participation of AI systems in improving their own capabilities, is beginning to move from theoretical prospect to practice, posing both challenges and opportunities for safety alignment. Models evolve through frequent updates, and their safety alignment requires continual adaptation to each new checkpoint. Meanwhile, with evolving red-teaming methods exposing new vulnerabilities, safety improvement for each checkpoint needs to mitigate exposed vulnerabilities and generalize to risks not yet revealed. Following R$^2$AI, we term these goals resistance to known threats and resilience to unforeseen risks. Recursive self-improvement, in turn, inspires an approach to both goals: safety alignment could likewise advance through successive rounds of evaluation and update. We therefore introduce ReSI, a recursive safety improvement framework that implements this approach through automated research. In each round, ReSI applies diverse red-teaming methods to identify vulnerabilities in the current target model, develops training recipes, and promotes the update with the largest safety gain among those passing a Pareto gate on capability retention as the next target model. Across four dense and mixture-of-experts models, ReSI matches or exceeds evaluated frontier models on in-distribution and out-of-distribution safety benchmarks, and outperforms alignment baselines on nearly all safety evaluations while largely preserving general capabilities. In particular, ReSI reduces the mean X-Teaming attack success rate across the four models from 86.01% to 31.45%, well below GPT-5.6-Luna's leading frontier result of 56.69%, indicating stronger resilience to attacks unseen during training. These findings support recursive safety improvement as a practical path toward resistant and resilient AI.
2610.12233.update_target: 目标模型安全训练配方与权重
2610.12233.mechanism_zh: 每轮自动红队发现漏洞、研究训练配方，再用能力保持的 Pareto 门槛选择安全增益最大的更新进入下一轮。
2610.12233.result_zh: 四个稠密/MoE 模型的 X-Teaming 平均攻击成功率从 86.01% 降至 31.45%，并评估分布内外安全性与通用能力保持。
2610.12233.boundary_zh: 安全指标提升依赖具体威胁集及能力门槛，不代表对任意未知攻击的保证。
2610.12233.abstract_zh: 递归自我改进，即 AI 系统参与改进自身能力，正开始从理论前景走向实践，为安全对齐同时带来挑战与机遇。模型通过频繁更新演化，安全对齐需要持续适应每个新检查点。同时，不断发展的红队方法暴露新漏洞，每个检查点的安全改进既要缓解已暴露漏洞，也要泛化到尚未揭示的风险。沿用 R²AI，我们将这两个目标称为对已知威胁的抵抗力和对未知风险的韧性。递归自我改进也启发了同时实现这两个目标的方法：安全对齐可以通过连续的评估与更新轮次推进。因此，我们提出 ReSI，一个通过自动研究实现此思路的递归安全改进框架。每轮中，ReSI 使用多种红队方法识别当前目标模型的漏洞，开发训练配方，并在通过能力保持 Pareto 门槛的更新中，选择安全增益最大的一个作为下一轮目标模型。在四个稠密及混合专家模型上，ReSI 在分布内和分布外安全基准上达到或超过所评估的前沿模型，在几乎所有安全评估上超过对齐基线，同时大体保留通用能力。尤其是，ReSI 将四个模型在 X-Teaming 下的平均攻击成功率从 86.01% 降至 31.45%，明显低于 GPT-5.6-Luna 在前沿模型中领先的 56.69%，显示出对训练时未见攻击更强的韧性。这些发现支持将递归安全改进作为通向具备抵抗力和韧性的 AI 的实用途径。
2610.12233.title: ReSI: Recursive Safety Improvement toward Resistant and Resilient AI
2610.12233.authors: Jingnan Zheng, Dongcheng Zhang, Yi Zhang, Ming Zhang, Qiaosheng Zhang, Youbang Sun, An Zhang, Xiangnan He, Tat-Seng Chua, Xia Hu, Bowen Zhou, Chaochao Lu, Xiang Wang

2610.11345.abstract_en: Self-evolving LLM agents promise to improve autonomously through continual interaction and learning, reducing their dependence on manually curated supervision. Realizing this promise requires not only updating the agent, but also evolving its training experience as its capabilities change. However, most existing pipelines rely on static datasets or separately updated synthesis models, causing previously useful tasks to become trivial while overly difficult tasks remain uninformative. This growing mismatch between agent capability and training experience limits sustained self-improvement. To address this problem, we propose SynCo, an agentic data synthesis co-training framework for self-evolving LLMs based on multi-agent reinforcement learning. SynCo jointly optimizes two independently parameterized agents: a Synthesizer that constructs training tasks from the Reasoner's evolving capability state, and a Reasoner that learns from the resulting experience. Each synthesized task induces multiple Reasoner rollouts whose outcomes provide complementary rewards to both agents. Correctness feedback improves the Reasoner, while task quality, answer reliability, and outcome-grounded teachability guide the Synthesizer. Their updates are fed back into subsequent synthesis rounds, allowing the task-solving policy and its training distribution to evolve together. Extensive experiments across eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SynCo substantially outperforms a broad range of existing synthetic-data methods and controlled baselines, achieving the strongest overall performance while deriving most of its gains from previously unsolved problems.
2610.11345.update_target: 任务合成器与推理器的参数、训练分布
2610.11345.mechanism_zh: 独立参数化的 Synthesizer 和 Reasoner 用多轨迹结果获得互补奖励；能力变化反馈到后续出题。
2610.11345.result_zh: 在八个数学推理基准上比较合成数据方法和受控基线，摘要报告主要收益来自原先未能解出的题。
2610.11345.boundary_zh: 验证集中在数学推理；共同演化任务与模型并不自动证明开放式科研中的可持续 RSI。
2610.11345.abstract_zh: 自进化 LLM 智能体有望通过持续交互与学习自主改进，减少对人工整理监督的依赖。实现这一前景，不仅要更新智能体，还要随着其能力变化演化训练经验。然而，多数现有流程依赖静态数据集或单独更新的合成模型，导致过去有用的任务变得简单，而过难任务仍不能提供信息。智能体能力与训练经验间不断扩大的失配限制了持续自改进。为此，我们提出 SynCo，一个基于多智能体强化学习、面向自进化 LLM 的智能体式数据合成协同训练框架。SynCo 联合优化两个参数彼此独立的智能体：Synthesizer 根据 Reasoner 不断变化的能力状态构造训练任务，Reasoner 则从所得经验中学习。每个合成任务产生多个 Reasoner 轨迹，其结果为两个智能体提供互补奖励。正确性反馈改进 Reasoner，而任务质量、答案可靠性和基于结果的可教性指导 Synthesizer。二者的更新反馈到后续合成轮次，使解题策略及其训练分布共同演化。在八个数学推理基准上的广泛实验表明，SynCo 明显超过多种现有合成数据方法和受控基线，取得最佳整体表现，大部分收益来自先前未能解决的问题。
2610.11345.title: SynCo: Data Synthesis Co-Training for Self-Evolving LLMs via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
2610.11345.authors: Wei Yang, Shawn Li, Yuehan Qin, Yawei Wang, Mingxi Wang, Shixuan Li, Tiankai Yang, Jiate Li, Jesse Thomason, Xuezhe Ma, Yue Zhao
2610.11345.affiliation: University of Southern California / George Washington University / Georgia Institute of Technology

2610.12367.abstract_en: Skills, reusable procedural guidance added at inference, can substantially improve LLM downstream performance (Li et al., 2026). Prior work retrieves skills from a bank by semantic relevance, then uses them as inference-time patches or for model distillation. The individual utility of each skill, however, is largely neglected. We first show that, in on-policy distillation where skill-conditioned policies serve as teachers, fewer than 25% of retrieved skills provide useful distillation signals. We then propose SGUID, a method for selecting a compact subset of skills for distillation. SGUID retains a skill only if it consistently yields effective learning signals during training. The selected skills are then distilled to produce a better model. Our results show that not all skills are worth distilling. Across four models from the Olmo and Qwen families, distilling 6 selected skills matches or exceeds full-bank distillation in mean avg@12 on three of the four models, and on all four after a second round that distills 3 newly selected skills, while the full banks are up to 11x larger. Importantly, SGUID supports stable model-skill co-evolution: after a distillation round, a new candidate bank is curated from the updated model's rollouts, and SGUID selects which skills to internalize next. In the second round, this loop selects 3 new skills and improves Qwen3-8B from 64.3% to 66.3%. The selection step is essential for stability: on Qwen3-4B, naively updating the model with unfiltered skills degrades performance, including a 0.3 percentage point drop on HMMT25, whereas SGUID improves HMMT25 by 0.5 points after the first round and 1.1 points after the second. These results identify skill selection as the key mechanism for stable model-skill co-evolution.
2610.12367.update_target: 技能银行与蒸馏后的模型权重
2610.12367.mechanism_zh: 选择持续提供有效学习信号的技能进行 on-policy 蒸馏，再从更新模型的轨迹构造新技能银行。
2610.12367.result_zh: 六项技能的蒸馏在多数模型上匹配或超过最多大 11 倍的完整技能库；第二轮三项新技能使 Qwen3-8B 从 64.3% 到 66.3%。
2610.12367.boundary_zh: 技能有效性是模型与阶段相关的；摘要只验证有限轮次，未证明任意次数共同演化稳定。
2610.12367.abstract_zh: 技能是在推理时添加的可复用过程指导，能够显著改善 LLM 的下游表现（Li et al., 2026）。先前工作按语义相关性从技能库检索技能，将其作为推理补丁或用于模型蒸馏，却大多忽略每项技能的独立效用。我们首先发现，在以技能条件化策略为教师的 on-policy 蒸馏中，少于 25% 的检索技能提供了有用的蒸馏信号。随后，我们提出 SGUID，选择紧凑的技能子集用于蒸馏。只有技能在训练中持续产生有效学习信号时，SGUID 才保留它，再蒸馏所选技能以得到更好的模型。结果表明，并非所有技能都值得蒸馏。在 Olmo 和 Qwen 系列的四个模型上，蒸馏六项所选技能，在四个模型中的三个上达到或超过完整技能库的平均 avg@12；第二轮蒸馏三项新选技能后，四个模型均达到或超过完整库，而完整库最多大 11 倍。SGUID 还支持稳定的模型—技能共同演化：一轮蒸馏后，从更新模型的轨迹整理新的候选库，再由 SGUID 决定下一轮内化哪些技能。第二轮选择三项新技能，将 Qwen3-8B 从 64.3% 提高到 66.3%。选择步骤对稳定性至关重要：在 Qwen3-4B 上，用未经筛选的技能直接更新模型会降低表现，包括 HMMT25 下降 0.3 个百分点；SGUID 则在首轮和第二轮后分别提高 0.5 与 1.1 点。这些结果将技能选择确定为稳定模型—技能共同演化的关键机制。
2610.12367.title: Which Skill to Distill? SGUID: Selecting a Compact Skill Bank for Model-Skill Co-Evolution
2610.12367.authors: Yuhan Liu, Xiyao Ma, Zhongkai Sun, Xu Han, Chengyuan Ma, Benjamin Z. Yao, Chenlei Guo

2610.10623.abstract_en: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) offer a parameter efficient approach to scaling reasoning by reusing shared parameters across recurrent computation steps. Despite their promise, effective post-training of LoopLMs remains challenging. Existing approaches either provide reward based supervision that is sparse or costly to extend across loops, or rely on external teachers or privileged information, leading to limited teacher availability or teacher-student context mismatch. To address these limitations, we introduce LoopOPD, a cross-loop on-policy distillation framework that uses additional recurrent computation within a LoopLM as its own source of supervision. LoopOPD uses a frozen terminal loop policy as a compute privileged teacher for an intermediate loop student on student generated rollouts, providing dense supervision without an external teacher or privileged information. We further propose Dynamic LoopOPD (D-LoopOPD), which continually refreshes the terminal loop teacher as the shared model parameters are updated, enabling recurrent self-improvement. We characterize how distillation updates propagate across loop depths and derive sufficient conditions under which a single update yields simultaneous local improvement at both loop depths. Experiments on Ouro-Thinking models show that LoopOPD improves mathematical reasoning, while D-LoopOPD yields further gains through dynamic teacher updates. Despite being trained only on mathematical data, the resulting models also improve on general reasoning and code generation benchmarks, demonstrating that recurrent computation can serve as an effective source of supervision for LoopLMs. Our code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.
2610.10623.update_target: 循环语言模型共享权重与动态末端教师
2610.10623.mechanism_zh: LoopOPD 用冻结的末端循环策略监督中间循环，D-LoopOPD 随共享权重更新持续刷新末端教师。
2610.10623.result_zh: Ouro-Thinking 模型上的数学推理改善，并迁移到通用推理和代码生成；代码及检查点承诺在接收后发布。
2610.10623.boundary_zh: 循环计算提供自监督是具体机制，不等同于系统自主改写训练算法；未发布资源不填 Code 链接。
2610.10623.abstract_zh: 循环语言模型（LoopLM）通过在重复计算步骤中复用共享参数，提供了一种参数高效的推理扩展方式。但其有效后训练仍有挑战。现有方法要么依靠跨循环稀疏或扩展成本高的奖励监督，要么依赖外部教师或特权信息，造成教师可用性受限或师生上下文失配。为此，我们提出跨循环 on-policy 蒸馏框架 LoopOPD，把同一 LoopLM 内额外的循环计算作为自身监督来源。LoopOPD 在学生生成的轨迹上，使用冻结的末端循环策略作为拥有更多计算资源的教师，监督中间循环学生，无需外部教师或特权信息即可提供稠密监督。我们进一步提出 Dynamic LoopOPD（D-LoopOPD），随着共享模型参数更新持续刷新末端循环教师，实现循环式自改进。我们刻画蒸馏更新如何跨循环深度传播，并推导出一次更新能在两个循环深度上同时产生局部改进的充分条件。在 Ouro-Thinking 模型上的实验表明，LoopOPD 改善数学推理，D-LoopOPD 通过动态教师更新获得进一步收益。虽然只在数学数据上训练，所得模型也在通用推理和代码生成基准上进步，说明循环计算可以成为 LoopLM 的有效监督来源。代码与模型检查点将在论文被接收后发布。
2610.10623.title: Recurrent Self-Improvement: Dynamic Cross-Loop On-Policy Distillation for Looped Language Models
2610.10623.authors: Yi Wang, Rui Qian, Yu Li, Haoyang Yao, Wenjie Wang
2610.10623.affiliation: ShanghaiTech University / Fudan University / Southeast University / Peking University

2610.11781.abstract_en: Interactive agents can turn experience into reusable skills, yet existing self-evolving skill libraries primarily improve by accumulating new knowledge. Failures may lead to new skills, while previously stored skills are less often revisited as new evidence arrives. However, growth alone does not ensure reliability, as a retrieved skill may be inapplicable under the current task conditions, and an existing skill may encode a mis-specified operational boundary. Reliable skill evolution therefore requires not only adding knowledge, but also testing and revising what is already stored. We introduce Skill-V, a verifiable self-evolving skill library. To make stored knowledge testable, we propose representing skills as versioned, falsifiable contracts that link semantic intent to observable behavioral criteria. We use environment outcomes to drive library evolution. Specifically, task failures motivate skill addition, while disagreements between contract evaluations and task outcomes guide revisions to existing skill boundaries. To validate these revisions, we require them to preserve protected semantic constraints and satisfy non-regression criteria for rubric-outcome metrics on historical replay evidence. Finally, we employ an applicability-aware filter to exclude candidates judged confidently inapplicable to the current task. Across ALFWorld and WebShop, Skill-V achieves success rates of 95.3% and 85.9%, respectively, while maintaining a more compact skill library than growth-oriented baselines. Applicability-aware filtering reduces incorrect skill invocations, and outcome-grounded revisions correct mis-specified skill boundaries without degrading performance on previously observed evidence. These results show that reliable skill evolution requires more than accumulating experience: the library must learn which knowledge to retain, when to revise it, and when it should be applied.
2610.11781.update_target: 带版本和可证伪契约的外部技能库
2610.11781.mechanism_zh: 失败触发技能添加，契约判断与任务结果的不一致触发边界修订；新版本须保持语义约束并通过历史重放非退化检查。
2610.11781.result_zh: ALFWorld 与 WebShop 成功率分别为 95.3% 和 85.9%，技能库比只增长的基线更紧凑。
2610.11781.boundary_zh: 已观测历史证据上的非退化不保证未见任务无退化，需独立测试边界修订。
2610.11781.abstract_zh: 交互智能体能够把经验转化为可复用技能，但现有自进化技能库主要通过积累新知识改进。失败会导致新技能产生，已经存储的技能却较少随着新证据被重新审视。然而，增长本身不能保证可靠性：检索出的技能可能不适用于当前条件，已有技能也可能编码了错误的操作边界。可靠技能进化因此不仅需要增加知识，还要测试和修订已存内容。我们提出可验证的自进化技能库 Skill-V。为使存储知识可测试，我们用版本化、可证伪的契约表示技能，把语义意图连接到可观测行为标准，并用环境结果驱动技能库演化。具体而言，任务失败推动技能添加，契约评估与任务结果之间的不一致指导已有技能边界修订。为验证修订，我们要求其保持受保护的语义约束，并在历史重放证据上满足评价准则—结果指标的非退化要求。最后，我们采用适用性感知过滤器，剔除被高置信判断为不适用于当前任务的候选技能。在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上，Skill-V 的成功率分别达到 95.3% 和 85.9%，同时比面向增长的基线保持更紧凑的技能库。适用性过滤减少错误技能调用，基于结果的修订能纠正错误技能边界，同时不降低此前观察证据上的表现。这些结果表明，可靠技能进化需要超越经验积累：技能库必须学习保留什么知识、何时修订，以及何时应用。
2610.11781.title: Skill-V: Verifiable Self-Evolving Skill Library for Interactive Agents
2610.11781.authors: Jie Ma, Zhipeng Qian, Yufei Ma, Zihan Liang, Jiayi Ji, Qingpeng Cai, Ben Chen, Peng Jiang, Xiaoshuai Sun
2610.11781.affiliation: Xiamen University / Kuaishou Technology / Nankai University

2610.11858.abstract_en: Agent skills provide reusable guidance for code agents, but incomplete or unsuitable guidance can impair task execution. To reduce the manual effort of skill refinement, recent approaches use LLMs to generate revisions from execution feedback. However, grounding these revisions in explicit behavioral evidence remains challenging. To address this gap, we propose SkillMorph, a skill-evolution approach based on trajectory-guided fault localization in agent skills. Its core idea is to link execution evidence to specific skill contents before generating revisions. Specifically, SkillMorph compares failure and success evidence in abstracted trajectories across repeated runs and tasks, incorporating changes between evolution loops to identify suspicious actions. It then uses these suspicious actions to localize edit sites in the skills and generate corresponding revisions. Experiments on SWE-Skills-Bench and CannBot show that the skills evolved by SkillMorph consistently achieve higher trial-level accuracy and execution consistency than the original skills and those from four existing skill-evolution methods. We have also applied SkillMorph to automated kernel generation with an AI operator-development team, which has accepted 6 skill-revision pull requests.
2610.11858.update_target: 编码 Agent 技能中的具体文本与操作指导
2610.11858.mechanism_zh: 比较跨任务及跨轮的成功/失败抽象轨迹，先定位可疑行为，再映射到技能编辑位置并修订。
2610.11858.result_zh: 在 SWE-Skills-Bench 与 CannBot 上，进化技能的试验准确率及执行一致性优于原技能和四种比较方法；团队接受了六个技能修订 PR。
2610.11858.boundary_zh: 被接受的 PR 属于应用反馈，并不单独证明全面任务收益；需控制轨迹采样与修改预算。
2610.11858.abstract_zh: 智能体技能为编程智能体提供可复用指导，但不完整或不合适的指导会损害执行。为减少人工细化技能的工作，近期方法利用 LLM 根据执行反馈生成修订，但如何把修订落实到明确行为证据上仍有挑战。为此，我们提出 SkillMorph，一种基于技能中轨迹引导故障定位的技能进化方法。核心思想是在生成修订前，将执行证据关联到具体技能内容。具体而言，SkillMorph 比较跨多次运行与任务的抽象轨迹中的失败和成功证据，并结合进化轮次之间的变化识别可疑动作，再用这些动作定位技能中的编辑位置并生成相应修订。在 SWE-Skills-Bench 和 CannBot 上，SkillMorph 进化出的技能，在试验级准确率和执行一致性方面持续优于原技能，以及四种现有技能进化方法得到的技能。我们还将 SkillMorph 应用于一个 AI 算子开发团队的自动内核生成，该团队已接受六个技能修订拉取请求。
2610.11858.title: Trajectory-Guided Fault Localization for Agent Skill Evolution
2610.11858.authors: Yu Ge, Linna Xie, Zhong Li, Yu Pei, Tian Zhang
2610.11858.affiliation: Nanjing University / Hong Kong Polytechnic University

2610.11552.abstract_en: Large language model agents can invoke tools fluently, but enterprise workflows demand more than selecting the right tools: actions must strictly comply with organizational policies, tool feedback often conceals hidden side effects under partial observability, and long-horizon tasks require persistent state tracking across multiple records. To address these challenges, we introduce E-Ledger, a multi-agent harness for safe and persistent execution. E-Ledger employs a code approval layer that checks every proposed action against policy before execution, and maintains a world ledger of verified hidden rules alongside evidence-backed dynamic state. Because hidden rules are typically unknown a priori, we further propose WorldAbduct, an abductive, world-model-driven harness evolution framework. WorldAbduct diagnoses execution trajectories across four complementary views (state consistency, world-observation gap, policy-gate correctness, and goal judgment) to hypothesize latent rules, and verifies them through targeted abductive interactions before integrating them into the ledger. On the enterprise benchmark World of Workflows, E-Ledger with WorldAbduct improves safe task completion across four LLM backbones, outperforming the strongest evolution baseline by 5--15 percentage points. Experiments in ScienceWorld and DiscoveryWorld further show that abductive harness evolution carries over to scientific environments. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/E-LEDGER-WorldAbduct.
2610.11552.update_target: 外部世界账本、隐含规则与 Agent 运行框架
2610.11552.mechanism_zh: E-Ledger 在动作前检查策略约束；WorldAbduct 从四种诊断视角提出隐含规则，并用定向交互验证后写入账本。
2610.11552.result_zh: World of Workflows 上跨四种 LLM，安全任务完成率比最强进化基线高 5–15 个百分点，并扩展到 ScienceWorld 与 DiscoveryWorld。
2610.11552.boundary_zh: 获得并保存环境规则属于外部模型和运行框架更新，不应描述为基础模型权重学习。
2610.11552.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体已经能熟练调用工具，但企业工作流要求更多：动作必须严格遵守组织策略，工具反馈在部分可观测条件下往往隐藏副作用，长任务还需要跨多条记录持续跟踪状态。为解决这些问题，我们提出用于安全、持久执行的多智能体运行框架 E-Ledger。它通过代码审批层在执行前检查每个拟议动作是否符合策略，并维护包含已验证隐含规则和证据支持动态状态的世界账本。由于隐含规则通常事先未知，我们进一步提出基于溯因与世界模型的框架进化方法 WorldAbduct。它从状态一致性、世界—观察差距、策略门正确性及目标判断四个互补视角诊断执行轨迹，提出潜在规则，再通过有针对性的溯因交互验证后整合进账本。在企业基准 World of Workflows 上，结合 WorldAbduct 的 E-Ledger 在四个 LLM 主干上提升安全任务完成表现，比最强进化基线高 5–15 个百分点。ScienceWorld 和 DiscoveryWorld 实验进一步显示，溯因式框架进化可迁移到科学环境。代码见 https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/E-LEDGER-WorldAbduct。
2610.11552.title: Safe, Persistent, and Evolving Agent Harness for Understanding Partially Observable Worlds
2610.11552.authors: Yisen Gao, Yue Guo, Qing Zong, Yiwen Guo, Yangqiu Song

2610.11373.abstract_en: Continual learning remains challenging for large language models, which must enable models to acquire new skills and knowledge without degrading existing capabilities. Existing approaches typically address this challenge by carefully designing how model parameters are updated. In contrast, prompt optimization avoids costly parameter updates while achieving competitive or even superior performance to reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO on individual knowledge-intensive and reasoning tasks. This raises a natural question: \textit{Can prompt optimization, as an efficient adaptation approach, be directly applied to continual learning?} Our analysis shows that, under sequential task adaptation, it suffers from catastrophic forgetting, while optimized prompts accumulate rules that overfit to local task distributions. To address these limitations, we propose \emph{Evolving Functional REpertoires} (EFRE), which replaces a single prompt with a repertoire of functions that evolves as new tasks arrive: compatible updates refine existing functions, while conflicting updates trigger the emergence of new ones. On a three-task continual-learning stream, EFRE achieves a final average performance 7.50 percentage points higher than GRPO. Moreover, after adaptation to the Bio task, its performance on FinQA decreases by only 1.56 percentage points, compared with 25.10 percentage points for the base prompt optimization method. We further instantiate EFRE in a minimal agent system and observe consistent improvements across different backbone models. Overall, these results demonstrate EFRE's strong performance in continual learning for large language models and highlight its substantial potential for continual learning in advanced agent systems.

2610.11373.update_target: 函数化提示词集合；无须参数更新
2610.11373.mechanism_zh: 兼容更新细化已有函数，冲突更新寻找其他可承载函数，必要时创建新函数，以历史一致性约束降低遗忘。
2610.11373.result_zh: 三任务流的最终平均表现较 GRPO 高 7.50 个百分点；适应 Bio 后 FinQA 下降 1.56 点，基础提示优化下降 25.10 点。
2610.11373.boundary_zh: 只有三个任务的持续学习流；长期函数库增长、路由成本和更多任务的遗忘仍需检验。
2610.11373.abstract_zh: 持续学习要求大语言模型获得新技能和知识，同时不损害已有能力，仍然十分困难。现有方法通常精心设计模型参数更新方式。相比之下，提示优化无需昂贵参数更新，在单项知识密集或推理任务上能够达到甚至超过 GRPO 等强化学习方法。这引出一个问题：作为高效适应方式，提示优化能否直接用于持续学习？我们的分析表明，在顺序任务适应中，提示优化也遭受灾难性遗忘，优化后的提示不断积累过拟合局部任务分布的规则。为解决这些问题，我们提出 Evolving Functional REpertoires（EFRE），用随新任务到来而演化的函数集合替代单个提示：兼容更新细化已有函数，冲突更新则触发新函数产生。在三任务持续学习流中，EFRE 的最终平均表现比 GRPO 高 7.50 个百分点。此外，在适应 Bio 任务后，它在 FinQA 上只下降 1.56 个百分点，而基础提示优化方法下降 25.10 点。我们还在一个最小智能体系统中实例化 EFRE，并观察到跨不同主干模型的一致改善。这些结果展示了 EFRE 在大语言模型持续学习上的较强表现，以及用于先进智能体系统持续学习的潜力。
2610.11373.title: From a Prompt to Repertoires: Evolving Functional REpertoires Enable LLM Continual Learning
2610.11373.authors: Fengyuan Liu, Yue Wang, Hangxi Guo, Fengyuan Liu, Chenxu Wu, Yanguang Liu, Mengnan Du
2610.11373.affiliation: CUHK Shenzhen / Shanghai AI Laboratory / USTC / New Jersey Institute of Technology / Independent Researcher

2610.12002.abstract_en: Test-time training (TTT) adapts an LLM's parameters using signals derived from test inputs, and can make striking improvements in pre-specified settings such as IMO competitions or designated open problems. By turning deployment experience into parameter updates, TTT provides a direct mechanism for model-level self-improvement. Yet TTT is not universally beneficial: each TTT algorithm works in different settings, and applying an ill-suited method could waste test-time compute or even damage model performance. Therefore, such parameter-level self-improvement requires agency: the model must decide when TTT is warranted, which algorithm to invoke, and whether an existing skill can be reused. To fill this gap, we introduce Agentic-TTT, which learns a test-time policy to govern those decisions. Agentic-TTT turns TTT procedures into callable tools, treats accumulated skills as an evolving deployment environment, and trains its policy using the observed utility gains from its decisions. On our benchmark, Agentic-TTT nearly doubles the utility over the backbone model, learns to trade off utility against compute, and generalizes to domains unseen during training. Together, these results point toward autonomous self-improvement: models that can decide how to learn from their own deployment experience.
2610.12002.update_target: 选择何时、如何执行测试时训练的策略，以及可复用技能
2610.12002.mechanism_zh: 将 TTT 程序封装为工具，用决策带来的效用增益训练调用策略，综合决定是否学习、采用何种算法或复用技能。
2610.12002.result_zh: 作者基准上效用接近主干模型的两倍，并报告计算—效用权衡及对训练未见领域的泛化。
2610.12002.boundary_zh: 效用的定义、训练和在线更新成本需结合正文比较；不是所有测试时更新都有效。
2610.12002.abstract_zh: 测试时训练（TTT）使用从测试输入中提取的信号适应 LLM 参数，在 IMO 竞赛或指定开放问题等预先限定场景中可带来显著提升。把部署经验转化为参数更新，使 TTT 成为模型级自改进的直接机制。但 TTT 并非普遍有效：不同算法适用于不同场景，使用不合适的方法可能浪费测试时计算，甚至损害模型表现。因此，这种参数级自改进需要自主决策能力：模型必须决定何时值得进行 TTT、调用哪种算法，以及能否复用已有技能。为此，我们提出 Agentic-TTT，学习一个管理这些决策的测试时策略。它将 TTT 过程转化为可调用工具，将积累的技能视为不断演化的部署环境，并利用决策带来的实际效用增益训练策略。在我们的基准上，Agentic-TTT 的效用接近主干模型的两倍，学会在效用与计算之间权衡，并泛化到训练时未见的领域。这些结果共同指向自主自改进：模型能够决定如何从自己的部署经验中学习。
2610.12002.title: Agentic-TTT: Training test-time policy for test-time training
2610.12002.categories: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2610.12002.affiliation: NUS AI Institute / National University of Singapore

2610.12086.abstract_en: LLM-based program evolution relies on evaluation feedback to guide the iterative search for high-performing programs. However, evaluation is often computationally expensive, making it essential to allocate limited resources to candidates that can most effectively advance the search. Existing LLM-based methods typically rely on fixed allocation strategies throughout the search, potentially wasting resources on low-value candidates while overlooking promising ones. We propose EvoAlloc, a self-evolving resource-allocation agent that learns from search experience to revise its strategy for allocating computational resources across candidates. EvoAlloc periodically consolidates prior search and allocation outcomes into reusable experience, which informs subsequent strategy revisions. It further uses a counterfactual exploration mechanism to occasionally evaluate candidates denied resources by the allocator, revealing their outcomes to enrich its experience for future strategy updates. Across coding and agent-harness optimization benchmarks, EvoAlloc requires 59-82% fewer full evaluations and 61-89% fewer total LLM tokens to reach baseline-level performance. Moreover, under the same full-evaluation budget, EvoAlloc achieves 8.7-12.0% higher final performance.
2610.12086.update_target: 程序进化中的计算资源分配策略与经验
2610.12086.mechanism_zh: 定期整理候选搜索和分配结果以修订策略，并反事实抽查原本被拒绝资源的候选。
2610.12086.result_zh: 达到基线性能所需完整评估减少 59–82%，LLM 总 token 减少 61–89%；相同完整评估预算下最终性能高 8.7–12.0%。
2610.12086.boundary_zh: 节省比例依赖候选分布和评估成本；反事实探索本身也必须计入总预算。
2610.12086.abstract_zh: 基于 LLM 的程序进化依靠评估反馈迭代搜索高性能程序。但评估通常昂贵，因此必须把有限资源分配给最可能推动搜索的候选。现有 LLM 方法通常在整个搜索中使用固定分配策略，可能把资源浪费在低价值候选上，同时忽略有潜力的候选。我们提出 EvoAlloc，一个从搜索经验中学习并修订跨候选计算资源分配策略的自进化资源分配智能体。EvoAlloc 定期将过去的搜索和分配结果整理为可复用经验，用于指导后续策略修订。它还采用反事实探索，偶尔评估被分配器拒绝资源的候选，揭示其结果以丰富未来策略更新所用经验。在编码和智能体运行框架优化基准上，EvoAlloc 达到基线水平所需的完整评估减少 59–82%，总 LLM token 减少 61–89%。此外，在相同完整评估预算下，其最终性能提高 8.7–12.0%。
2610.12086.title: EvoAlloc: A Self-Evolving Resource Allocation Agent for Efficient Program Evolution
2610.12086.authors: Yanning Dai, Yuhui Wang, Nanbo Li, Wenyi Wang, Jürgen Schmidhuber

2610.11354.abstract_en: Rule-governed contextual decision tasks require models to apply specified rules to case-specific context and evidence. Written rules can leave gaps in decision guidance and process evaluation, while reference judgments vary in their support from the rules and evidence. To address these challenges, we introduce AdaptEvo, a framework for learning under imperfect supervision that couples confidence-adaptive policy optimization with evolving decision knowledge and evaluation rubrics. Its Training module uses Confidence-Adaptive GRPO (CA-GRPO) to balance outcome and process rewards according to reference confidence. Its Evolution module synthesizes reusable decision knowledge from recurring failures across training cases and refines process rubrics to detect overlooked errors. To support empirical evaluation, we construct an industrial multimodal content moderation dataset comprising a training set and In-Period and Out-of-Period test sets, with the latter collected under changed rules. Using Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, AdaptEvo achieves 61.9% exact-label accuracy and 72.2% binary decision accuracy on In-Period, exceeding GRPO by 7.5 and 3.7 percentage points, respectively. On Out-of-Period, the policy trained with CA-GRPO retains exact-label accuracy gains over the base model across evaluated checkpoints without injected decision knowledge, while GRPO declines with continued training. CA-GRPO also outperforms the tested fixed reward mixtures on both Out-of-Period metrics.
2610.11354.update_target: 策略权重、可复用决策知识与过程评价准则
2610.11354.mechanism_zh: CA-GRPO 按参考判断置信度平衡结果和过程奖励；Evolution 模块从重复失败中提炼知识并修订评价准则。
2610.11354.result_zh: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在 In-Period 的精确标签/二元准确率为 61.9%/72.2%，比 GRPO 高 7.5/3.7 个百分点。
2610.11354.boundary_zh: 实验是特定工业内容审核任务；规则变化下的稳定性不等于通用自监督可靠。
2610.11354.abstract_zh: 受规则约束的上下文决策任务要求模型把指定规则应用到个案上下文与证据。书面规则可能在决策指导和过程评估上留有空白，参考判断受到规则和证据支持的程度也不同。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 AdaptEvo，将置信度自适应策略优化与不断演化的决策知识和评价准则结合，用于不完美监督下的学习。Training 模块采用置信度自适应 GRPO（CA-GRPO），按参考置信度平衡结果奖励与过程奖励；Evolution 模块从跨训练案例反复出现的失败中综合可复用决策知识，并细化过程评价准则以识别被遗漏的错误。为支持实证评估，我们构建工业多模态内容审核数据集，包括训练集、In-Period 测试集，以及在规则变化后收集的 Out-of-Period 测试集。使用 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 时，AdaptEvo 在 In-Period 上达到 61.9% 精确标签准确率和 72.2% 二元决策准确率，分别超过 GRPO 7.5 和 3.7 个百分点。在 Out-of-Period 上，无需注入决策知识，CA-GRPO 训练的策略在所评估检查点均保留相对基础模型的精确标签准确率收益，而 GRPO 随持续训练退化。CA-GRPO 在两个 Out-of-Period 指标上也超过所测试的固定奖励混合。
2610.11354.title: AdaptEvo: Adaptive Agent Learning with Evolving Supervision
2610.11354.authors: Shijun Wan, Jiancong Xie, Hang Xu, Jin Duan, Qixiong Wang, Xi Xiang, Maofei Que, Yahui Liu, Zhongyu Wei, Mu Chuan
2610.11354.affiliation: Fudan University / Sun Yat-sen University / Xiaohongshu

2610.10782.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs), but it typically assumes a static training environment. As the actor improves, fixed tasks drift out of its learning frontier: many become trivial, others remain unsolvable; and the learning signal collapses. We argue that VLM post-training should evolve the visual environment alongside the actor, not just the actor itself. We propose VICO, a co-evolutionary framework in which an actor and an Environment-as-Rewriter (EnvRewriter) are trained jointly: the EnvRewriter edits verifiable image-side structures, such as scene graphs, chart tables, or protected region masks, and re-renders them to produce label-valid training samples whose difficulty is calibrated to the actor's current ability through a pass-rate-based reward. This loop continuously realigns task difficulty with actor capability without any additional human annotation. Across nine multimodal benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning and visually grounded understanding, VICO-8B improves over its base model by up to +5.0% on out-of-domain tasks, surpasses the strongest self-evolution and text-editing co-evolution baselines by +4.3% and +8.4% respectively, and stays comparable to chart-specialized RLVR methods using 16-160 times fewer labeled samples. By shifting from human-labeled supervision to image-editing co-evolution, VICO offers a scalable path beyond static-corpus RLVR for visual reasoning.
2610.10782.update_target: VLM actor 与图像环境重写器的参数
2610.10782.mechanism_zh: EnvRewriter 修改可验证的场景图、图表或保护区域并重渲染，以通过率奖励校准任务难度，与 actor 联合训练。
2610.10782.result_zh: 九个多模态基准；VICO-8B 域外任务相对基础模型最高 +5.0%，标注量为图表专用 RLVR 方法的 1/16–1/160 时仍有可比表现。
2610.10782.boundary_zh: 属于训练环境与模型共同演化；需要区分重渲染的标签正确性与未见真实图像表现。
2610.10782.abstract_zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已经成为视觉语言模型（VLM）后训练的常用方案，但通常假设训练环境静态。随着 actor 改进，固定任务逐渐偏离其学习前沿：许多变得过于简单，另一些仍不可解，学习信号因而减弱。我们认为，VLM 后训练应让视觉环境与 actor 一起演化，而不只更新 actor。我们提出共同进化框架 VICO，联合训练 actor 与作为环境重写器的 EnvRewriter。EnvRewriter 编辑场景图、图表表格或受保护区域掩码等可验证的图像侧结构，并重新渲染，生成标签有效的训练样本；基于通过率的奖励使样本难度适配 actor 的当前能力。该循环无需新增人工标注，即可持续重新对齐任务难度与 actor 能力。在涵盖数学推理和视觉扎根理解的九个多模态基准上，VICO-8B 在域外任务上相对基础模型最高提升 5.0%，相对最强自进化及文本编辑共同进化基线分别高 4.3% 和 8.4%；使用少 16–160 倍的标注样本时，仍与图表专用 RLVR 方法相当。通过从人工标注监督转向图像编辑共同进化，VICO 为视觉推理提供了超越静态语料 RLVR 的可扩展路径。
2610.10782.title: VICO: Visual Environments Co-Evolving for Vision-Language Model Reasoning
2610.10782.authors: Meng Lu, Ligeng Zhu, Olivia Xiao, Yuchen Zhuang, Zihan Wang, Kuncheng Wu, Bangya Liu, Yu Wang, Charles Fleming, Wenqi Shi, Xuan Wang
2610.10782.categories: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

2610.12403.abstract_en: Skill-augmented agents improve sample efficiency by distilling successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Yet most existing approaches remain text-centric, linearizing spatial layouts and action-state correspondences into language that loses critical geometric structure. Recent efforts have begun incorporating visual evidence, but construct and update skills separately from policy optimization, leaving their mutual improvement underexplored. We propose ViSkill, a visual-native skill learning framework that encodes successful interactions as composite visual skill cards directly accessible to VLM agents. Retrieved skills guide both inference and reward shaping, while successful trajectories are distilled back into the library, forming a closed feedback loop in which skill accumulation and policy improvement reinforce each other. An optional cold-start mechanism further accelerates early-stage learning. Evaluated on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and PrimitiveSkill, ViSkill achieves an overall success rate of 0.89, rising to 0.91 with cold-start initialization, outperforming all evaluated proprietary and open-source baselines while converging faster than standard PPO. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill.
2610.12403.update_target: 视觉原生技能库与 VLM 策略
2610.12403.mechanism_zh: 成功轨迹形成复合视觉技能卡；检索技能指导推理和奖励塑形，新成功轨迹再写回技能库。
2610.12403.result_zh: Sokoban、FrozenLake 和 PrimitiveSkill 总体成功率 0.89，冷启动后 0.91，且比标准 PPO 更快收敛。
2610.12403.boundary_zh: 技能库增长与奖励塑形会同时改变训练条件，需拆分二者的作用并审计技能污染。
2610.12403.abstract_zh: 技能增强智能体通过把成功轨迹提炼为可复用策略，提高样本效率。但多数现有方法以文本为中心，将空间布局和动作—状态对应关系线性化为语言，丢失关键几何结构。近期工作开始纳入视觉证据，却把技能构建和更新与策略优化分开，尚未充分研究两者相互促进的可能。我们提出视觉原生技能学习框架 ViSkill，把成功交互编码为 VLM 智能体可直接访问的复合视觉技能卡。检索出的技能同时指导推理和奖励塑形，而成功轨迹又被提炼回技能库，形成技能积累与策略改进相互强化的反馈闭环。可选的冷启动机制进一步加速早期学习。在 Sokoban、FrozenLake 和 PrimitiveSkill 上，ViSkill 总体成功率为 0.89，加入冷启动后为 0.91，超过所有评估的闭源与开源基线，同时比标准 PPO 更快收敛。代码见 https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill。
2610.12403.title: ViSkill: Reinforcing VLM Agents with Evolving Visual-Native Skills
2610.12403.authors: Hongxing Li, Dingming Li, Yixin Li, Yong Du, Wenqi Zhang, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen
2610.12403.categories: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

2610.12469.abstract_en: Instruction-guided image editors have become highly capable, yet improving them further still depends on human-edited training pairs or external reward models. Such supervision is costly to obtain and can reward plausible failures: a realistic output may leave the requested change undone or alter content that should be preserved. In this work, we strive to improve a pretrained image editor using only its own generations, without human-edited targets or an external training-time reward model. To this end, we propose a self-evolving framework, named Rubric-CEPR, that verifies the editor's own samples with its internal representations through a rubric-augmented Contrastive Edit-Preservation Reward (CEPR). A Planner proposes structured edit instructions from unlabeled images, the Editor samples multiple candidate edits, and a frozen Critic scores each candidate with decomposed rubric checks for edit realization, removal of the old state, and content preservation, using features already exposed by the editor. Non-compensatory gates reject infeasible candidates, and the best verified candidate is distilled into the editor through lightweight adapter training. On Qwen-Image-Edit, Rubric-CEPR improves ImgEdit from 4.36 to 4.60 (+5.5%), with a +24.9% gain on object isolation, and transfers to GEdit-Bench and Complex-Edit. The same procedure also improves Step1X-Edit by +7.8% on ImgEdit. We hope our approach will serve as a solid baseline for image editors that improve themselves from their own verified samples. Our code is publicly available at $\href{https://riteshthawkar.github.io/Rubric-CEPR/}{\text{this URL}}$
2610.12469.update_target: 图像编辑模型的轻量适配器
2610.12469.mechanism_zh: Planner 从无标签图像提出编辑指令；冻结 Critic 利用编辑器内部表示与分解准则验收，再蒸馏最佳有效候选。
2610.12469.result_zh: Qwen-Image-Edit 的 ImgEdit 从 4.36 到 4.60（+5.5%），物体隔离 +24.9%；Step1X-Edit 上 +7.8%。
2610.12469.boundary_zh: 自生成样本蒸馏是局部自改进机制；冻结 Critic 的盲点和反复训练稳定性仍需外部验证。
2610.12469.abstract_zh: 指令引导的图像编辑器已相当强大，但进一步提升仍依赖人工编辑训练对或外部奖励模型。此类监督成本高，也可能奖励看似合理的失败：真实感输出可能没有执行所要求修改，或改动了应保留的内容。本文尝试只用预训练编辑器自己的生成结果改进它，无需人工编辑目标或训练时外部奖励模型。为此，我们提出自进化框架 Rubric-CEPR，通过评价准则增强的对比式编辑—保持奖励（CEPR），利用编辑器内部表示验证自身样本。Planner 从无标签图像提出结构化编辑指令，Editor 采样多个候选编辑，冻结的 Critic 利用编辑器已提供的特征，分别检查编辑实现、旧状态移除和内容保持。不可相互抵消的门控拒绝不可行候选，再通过轻量适配器训练把最佳已验证候选蒸馏回编辑器。在 Qwen-Image-Edit 上，Rubric-CEPR 将 ImgEdit 从 4.36 提高到 4.60（+5.5%），其中物体隔离提升 24.9%，并迁移到 GEdit-Bench 和 Complex-Edit。同一流程也使 Step1X-Edit 在 ImgEdit 上提升 7.8%。我们希望它成为编辑器通过自身已验证样本改善自己的可靠基线。代码公开于 https://riteshthawkar.github.io/Rubric-CEPR/。
2610.12469.title: Rubric-CEPR: Self-Evolving Image Editing via Reward-Verified Self-Distillation
2610.12469.authors: Ritesh Thawkar, Shubham Patle, Shravan Venkatraman, Rao Muhammad Anwer
2610.12469.affiliation: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

2610.12391.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often struggle to identify and use geometric relations in diagrams. Recent methods address this challenge by converting geometric entities, relations, and constraints into explicit textual representations for the model to reason over. However, effective formalization is highly non-trivial: on Geometry3K, structure injection fixes 28 errors but introduces 13 new ones among 200 examples. Redundant relations can distract the model, while ambiguous references to diagram elements can lead it to apply constraints incorrectly. This suggests that the key challenge is not merely extracting more geometric facts, but organizing them into representations that support downstream reasoning. To fully exploit the power of formalization, we further propose GeoReform, a reflective formalization evolution framework that treats formalization as an optimizable policy rather than a fixed parser output. GeoReform executes the full reasoning pipeline, collects failed rollouts, diagnoses defects in the current representation, and mutates the policy to better select, ground, group, and present geometric entities, relations, constraints, and targets. On Geometry3K, GeoReform improves Qwen3VL-2B accuracy from 42.0\% to 56.0\%. Extensive experiments and analyses across geometry reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that effective formalization is crucial for improving multimodal geometry reasoning.
2610.12391.update_target: 几何图的形式化表示策略
2610.12391.mechanism_zh: 运行完整推理流程，从失败轨迹诊断表示缺陷，再修改几何实体、关系、约束与目标的选择和呈现策略。
2610.12391.result_zh: Geometry3K 上 Qwen3VL-2B 准确率从 42.0% 提高到 56.0%；初始分析中，200 例的结构注入修复 28 错但引入 13 新错。
2610.12391.boundary_zh: 改进的是形式化策略，不能把单一几何基准收益说成模型一般推理能力持续增长。
2610.12391.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）经常难以识别和利用图中的几何关系。近期方法把几何实体、关系和约束转为显式文本表示，供模型推理。但有效形式化并不容易：在 Geometry3K 的 200 个样例中，注入结构修复了 28 个错误，却引入 13 个新错误。冗余关系可能干扰模型，对图中元素的歧义指代可能使约束被错误应用。这表明关键不只是提取更多几何事实，而是把它们组织成支持下游推理的表示。为充分发挥形式化的潜力，我们提出反思式形式化进化框架 GeoReform，将形式化视为可优化策略，而不是固定解析器输出。GeoReform 执行完整推理流程、收集失败轨迹、诊断当前表示的缺陷，再变异策略，以更好地选择、扎根、分组并呈现几何实体、关系、约束和目标。在 Geometry3K 上，GeoReform 将 Qwen3VL-2B 准确率从 42.0% 提高到 56.0%。跨几何推理基准的广泛实验与分析表明，有效形式化对于改善多模态几何推理至关重要。
2610.12391.title: GeoReform: Reflective Formalization Evolution for Multimodal Geometry Problem Solving
2610.12391.authors: Jialu Wang, Ruichen Zhang, Xiaoou Liu, Hua Wei, Tianlong Chen
2610.12391.affiliation: Tongji University / UNC Chapel Hill / Arizona State University

2610.12374.abstract_en: Interactive virtual worlds allow agents to learn through exploration and interaction. What agents can learn is bounded by the environments they practice in, which must be faithful, with consistent state, rules, and dynamics, and realistic, with observations that follow the real-world visual distributions. Achieving both across diverse worlds remains a bottleneck. We introduce AgentGarten, a framework that couples simulators and game engines with a shared neural renderer to build real-time interactive environments. Its simulation backends maintain persistent world state and execute program-defined interaction rules, while the renderer generates visual observations from structured conditions exported through a common interface. To build the neural renderer, we adapt a pretrained video model to geometry conditions, distill it with our proposed Adversarial Forcing, and optimize inference for real-time interaction. Adversarial Forcing makes history prefilling differentiable through exact replay, so that losses on later predictions update how the renderer encodes prior observations, and adds real-data adversarial supervision to improve its visual quality. In AgentGarten, agents perceive the world through visual observations, interact with it in real time, and improve by distilling each round of experience into playbooks that subsequent agents inherit and refine. Our empirical study demonstrates a substantial gain in learning efficiency, with agents learning from just 4 rounds compared with millions for a conventional reinforcement learning counterpart. As new worlds can be written as code and rendered through the same interface, environments can scale in both number and difficulty alongside their agents, a step toward agents that keep evolving through interactive experience.
2610.12374.update_target: 交互环境与跨轮继承、修订的 playbook
2610.12374.mechanism_zh: 模拟器保持状态和规则，神经渲染器生成观察；每轮交互经验提炼成后继 Agent 继承并修订的行动手册。
2610.12374.result_zh: 作者报告四轮经验学习即可取得显著效率收益，对照传统 RL 需要百万量级轮次。
2610.12374.boundary_zh: 不同方法的轮次单位、成本及先验不同，不可把 4 对百万直接解释为等预算加速比。
2610.12374.abstract_zh: 交互虚拟世界使智能体能够通过探索和交互学习。可学内容受练习环境限制：环境既需忠实，具有一致状态、规则和动力学，也需真实，观察应符合现实视觉分布。在多样世界中同时做到二者仍是瓶颈。我们提出 AgentGarten，将模拟器和游戏引擎与共享神经渲染器结合，构建实时交互环境。模拟后端维护持久世界状态并执行程序定义的交互规则，渲染器则根据公共接口输出的结构化条件生成视觉观察。为构建渲染器，我们将预训练视频模型适配到几何条件，通过提出的 Adversarial Forcing 蒸馏，并优化实时推理。Adversarial Forcing 通过精确重放，使历史预填充可微，让后续预测损失更新渲染器对早期观察的编码方式，同时加入真实数据对抗监督改善视觉质量。在 AgentGarten 中，智能体通过视觉观察感知世界、实时交互，并把每轮经验提炼为后继智能体继承和细化的行动手册，从而改进。实证研究表明学习效率显著提升：智能体仅需四轮学习，相比之下传统强化学习对应方法需要百万量级轮次。由于新世界可以用代码编写并通过同一接口渲染，环境的数量和难度可随智能体扩展，这是迈向通过交互经验持续进化智能体的一步。
2610.12374.title: AgentGarten: Code Worlds for Evolving Agents
2610.12374.authors: Jiawei Chi, Shangchen Miao, Zhiyuan Shi, Kailu Wu, Hanyang Wang, Weiliang Chen, Qiyu Dai, Jinshan Ren, Jun Gao, Mingsheng Long, Yueqi Duan, Jiangran Lyu, Jialong Wu, Fangfu Liu

2610.12124.abstract_en: The evolution of Large Language Model agents from single-task execution to long-term autonomous operation highlights the critical challenge of transforming continuous experiences into reusable knowledge. To address this, we propose Hippocam, a hierarchical memory and continual learning architecture. Hippocam draws inspiration from two characteristics of human memory: cognitive processes selectively maintain information relevant to current goals, while long-term memories form gradually through repeated consolidation. Accordingly, Hippocam structures an agent's ongoing work as nested intents. The active context remains centered on the current intent, while completed intents are consolidated into the task-relevant outcomes and state needed for subsequent work, rather than carrying forward their full working details. Concurrently, a recursive prefix consolidation mechanism repeatedly consolidates earlier history, causing long-unused experiences to become increasingly abstract. Original interactions are preserved, allowing the agent to progressively recover finer-grained details through the hierarchy and stop once sufficient information is available. Crucially, when past experiences are recalled and reintegrated into active work, they undergo subsequent consolidation alongside new experiences, thereby being reinforced, supplemented, and updated. Through this memory dynamic of use and disuse, Hippocam connects working context, long-term memory, knowledge accumulation, and skill learning within a single continuously evolving experiential process. This enables agents to learn and evolve capabilities through their own experiences without parameter updates.
2610.12124.update_target: 分层意图记忆、经验摘要与技能；无参数更新
2610.12124.mechanism_zh: 按嵌套意图整理当前工作，递归压缩旧历史但保留原始交互；被重新调用的经验与新经验共同巩固和更新。
2610.12124.result_zh: 摘要给出统一工作上下文、长期记忆、知识积累与技能学习的机制，没有提供量化提升数值。
2610.12124.boundary_zh: 作为经验进化机制收录；没有摘要定量结果时，不自行补写性能优势或持续增益。
2610.12124.abstract_zh: 大语言模型智能体从单任务执行走向长期自主运行，使“如何把连续经验转化为可复用知识”成为关键挑战。为此，我们提出分层记忆与持续学习架构 Hippocam。它借鉴人类记忆的两个特点：认知过程有选择地维持与当前目标相关的信息，长期记忆则通过反复巩固逐渐形成。因此，Hippocam 将智能体持续工作组织为嵌套意图。活动上下文始终以当前意图为中心，已经完成的意图被整合为后续工作需要的任务相关结果和状态，而不继续携带完整工作细节。同时，递归前缀巩固机制反复整合更早历史，使长期未使用的经验逐渐抽象化。原始交互仍被保留，智能体可沿层级逐步恢复更细信息，并在信息充足时停止。关键是，旧经验一旦被回忆并重新融入当前工作，就会与新经验一起继续被巩固，从而得到强化、补充和更新。通过这种使用与弃用的记忆动态，Hippocam 在统一、持续演化的经验过程中连接工作上下文、长期记忆、知识积累和技能学习，使智能体无需参数更新即可通过自身经验学习并演化能力。
2610.12124.title: Use and Disuse: Intent-Structured Experience Consolidation for Memory and Learning in LLM Agents
2610.12124.authors: Xiangyi Zeng, Baihang Liu, Xutong Wang, Ze Jin, Yunpeng Li, Qixu Liu
2610.12124.affiliation: Institute of Information Engineering, CAS / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

2610.12235.abstract_en: AI research agents automate the cycle of proposing, implementing, and evaluating experiments, opening a path toward recursive self-improvement. Yet their ability to propose experiments outpaces their capacity to execute them in real environments, making outcome prediction a key capability for sustained self-improvement under limited experimental budgets. We investigate language models as Research World Models (RWMs), which predict the outcomes of candidate interventions across research environments. Our evaluation draws on over 2,600 experimental records from nine research environments spanning pretraining, post-training, and inference, representing more than 171,000 H100 GPU-hours of experimentation. Research knowledge acquired from real experimental experience improves RWM predictions of unseen interventions within the same environment (Spearman +0.27), and can be reused across environments. For example, using only pretraining experience from OLMo3, Marin, and Nanochat, an RWM reduces selection regret in the Qwen3 environment by 78% compared with zero-experience setting. These benefits extend to multi-round Autoresearch under a fixed selection budget: RWMs with in-env and cross-env research knowledge increase the best gain achieved by 15.8% and 11.6%, respectively. Ablations across 13 language models used as RWMs show that adding research knowledge can improve intervention ranking more than changing models or increasing reasoning effort alone. These findings support language models as RWMs and motivate accumulating experimental data for future RWM training.
2610.12235.update_target: 由实验经验支撑的科研结果预测与候选选择
2610.12235.mechanism_zh: RWM 预测候选研究干预的结果，复用同环境及跨环境实验知识，在固定选择预算下指导多轮 Autoresearch。
2610.12235.result_zh: 超过 2,600 条实验记录、九类环境、171,000 H100 GPU 小时；有经验时固定预算最佳增益提高 15.8%/11.6%。
2610.12235.boundary_zh: 171,000 GPU 小时是所依赖实验记录规模，不能写成这套方法本身的低成本；预算内选择增益不等于预测器权重自主改进。
2610.12235.abstract_zh: AI 研究智能体自动化提出、实现和评估实验的循环，为递归自我改进打开路径。但提出实验的能力超过了在真实环境执行的能力，因此结果预测是有限实验预算下持续自改进的关键。我们研究作为研究世界模型（RWM）的语言模型，它们预测跨研究环境的候选干预结果。评估使用九个涵盖预训练、后训练和推理的研究环境中的 2,600 多条实验记录，代表超过 171,000 H100 GPU 小时的实验。由真实实验经验获得的研究知识，改善 RWM 对同环境未见干预的预测（Spearman 增加 0.27），也能跨环境复用。例如，仅使用 OLMo3、Marin 和 Nanochat 的预训练经验，RWM 就能使 Qwen3 环境中的选择遗憾相对零经验设置降低 78%。这些收益扩展到固定选择预算下的多轮 Autoresearch：具有环境内和跨环境研究知识的 RWM，使取得的最佳增益分别提高 15.8% 和 11.6%。跨 13 个作为 RWM 的语言模型的消融表明，增加研究知识对干预排序的改善，可能超过单独换用模型或提高推理投入。这些发现支持将语言模型作为 RWM，并鼓励为未来 RWM 训练积累实验数据。
2610.12235.title: Language Models as AI Research World Models
2610.12235.authors: Zijun Wang, Zewen Liu, Minhua Lin, Zhaotian Weng, Zhan Shi, Bing He, Yisi Sang, Dakuo Wang, Benoit Dumoulin, Wei Jin, Yuyin Zhou, Cihang Xie, Hanqing Lu

2610.11464.abstract_en: We changed the agent: did it actually get better? Every self-improving agent loop answers this hundreds of times, and every answer comes from a verifier. On open-ended tasks none exists, so the loop is handed a hand-written rubric or a bare LLM judge grading output from a model like itself, inviting reward hacking and shared blind spots. We make the verifier the evolving object: an inspectable expression over small, mostly deterministic drawback detectors, synthesized from clustered failures, gated at birth, and selected for agreement with a ten-item anchored reference set plus consensus over unlabeled outputs, never for the agent's score. On MBPP+ it gains +0.21 held-out agreement over the hand-authored seed composition, on every seed, and ends ahead of the bare LLM judge it contains. One finding should change how co-evolved verifiers are validated: removing the anchor guards collapses the verifier into a vacuous always-pass grader, yet that collapsed verifier trains skills just as well. Downstream task score cannot certify a self-evolved verifier. Score does answer sufficiency, and there an evolved verifier can substitute: Double Ratchet, pairing the verifier with a lifecycle-managed skill loop, retains 88-110% of the lift that ground truth or a rubric buys the same loop, across code generation, enterprise text-to-SQL, and reference-free report generation. When evolved skills gamed the report rubric, an outer judge caught it and one added detector repaired it; the judge itself was wrong until given the task contract.
2610.11464.image_note: Figure 1, PDF page 3; crop of the original PDF
2610.11464.update_target: 可检查的验证器表达式，以及消费该验证器的技能闭环
2610.11464.mechanism_zh: 从失败簇合成小型缺陷检测器，以十项锚定参考和无标签一致性选择验证器，选择目标不是 Agent 得分。
2610.11464.result_zh: MBPP+ 留出一致性较手写组合提高 0.21；去掉锚定保护会退化为总是通过的评分器，但下游技能仍可能变好。
2610.11464.boundary_zh: 下游分数上涨不能认证验证器正确性，是本篇最应保留的证据边界。
2610.11464.abstract_zh: 我们修改了智能体：它真的变好了吗？每个自改进闭环都会回答这一问题数百次，而每个答案都来自验证器。开放任务没有现成验证器，因此闭环往往依靠手写评价准则，或由类似模型的裸 LLM 评委评分，容易出现奖励利用和共同盲点。我们让验证器本身演化：它是由小型、主要确定性的缺陷检测器组成的可检查表达式，从聚类失败中综合，在产生时接受门控，并按与十项锚定参考集的一致性及无标签输出共识来选择，绝不按智能体得分选择。在 MBPP+ 上，它在每个随机种子下都比手写初始组合提高 0.21 的留出一致性，最终超过其包含的裸 LLM 评委。一项发现应改变共同进化验证器的验证方式：移除锚定保护会使验证器崩溃为毫无意义的“总是通过”评分器，但这个失效验证器仍能同样有效地训练技能。因此，下游任务得分不能认证自进化验证器。得分能够回答充分性问题，而在这一点上进化验证器可以替代外部信号：Double Ratchet 将验证器与具有生命周期管理的技能闭环结合，在代码生成、企业文本转 SQL 和无参考报告生成上，保留真实答案或评价准则给同一闭环带来的 88–110% 增益。当进化技能利用报告准则漏洞时，外部评委发现问题，加入一个检测器便完成修复；但这个评委本身也曾判断错误，直到获得任务契约。
2610.11464.title: Who Verifies the Verifier? Co-Evolving Inspectable Graders with Self-Improving Agents
2610.11464.authors: Xing Zhang, Guanghui Wang, Yanwei Cui, Ziyuan Li, Wei Qiu, Bing Zhu, Peiyang He
2610.11464.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
