2610.11655.abstract_en: Improving a long-horizon LLM agent means evolving the harness around a frozen model or training its weights. We let a self-evolving harness make the system stronger first, then cross seed and evolved harnesses with base and trained weights to learn which gains the trained model keeps and which still need the runtime. We show that the right lever can be read off the agent's failure composition: labelling failed trajectories by the first signal that fires separates process failures (blocked calls, loops, exhausted step budgets) from content failures (a delivered plan that is poor). Harness evolution repairs the former, the behaviour it instils can be trained into the weights, and content failures are what weight training is for. On DeepPlanning, a self-evolving harness loop lifts the held-out score of Qwen3.5-4B from 0.16 to 0.30 and of Qwen3.5-9B from 0.32 to 0.44; for 4B, held-out delivery rises from 55% to 90% while content failures are left for the weights. LoRA adapters trained on evolved-harness trajectories internalise the gain: under the original harness they add +0.13 on held-out tasks for both sizes; on 4B they stack with the harness to more than double the held-out score, and on 9B the adapter alone matches the full evolution line, cutting content failures from a quarter of trajectories to one in twenty. A placebo adapter trained on answer-shuffled trajectories falls below the base model. The loop transfers to WebArena-Lite (+0.09 on 117 unseen tasks), where the gain lives in what the model sees and adapters do not add to it. The result is a diagnose-then-intervene rule applied twice: read the failure composition to choose between harness and weights, then read what the accepted edits changed to decide which gains to train in. Scores are four-rollout means against fresh anchors, same-night except where marked, across eight models from six families and two benchmarks.
2610.11655.image_note: Figure 1, PDF page 2; crop of the original PDF
2610.11655.update_target: 框架与权重的干预选择，以及轨迹 LoRA 内化
2610.11655.mechanism_zh: 按首个失败信号区分流程和内容错误，交叉比较初始/进化框架与基础/训练权重；加入答案打乱的安慰剂适配器。
2610.11655.result_zh: DeepPlanning 上 4B 的留出得分 0.16→0.30、9B 为 0.32→0.44；LoRA 在原框架下均再带来 +0.13。
2610.11655.boundary_zh: WebArena-Lite 上适配器没有额外收益，说明“把框架收益内化到权重”具有任务依赖性。
2610.11655.abstract_zh: 改进长任务 LLM 智能体，可以演化冻结模型外围的运行框架，也可以训练权重。我们先让自进化框架增强系统，再交叉组合初始和进化框架与基础和训练后权重，以了解哪些收益被模型保留，哪些仍依赖运行时。我们发现，可以从失败构成读出合适的干预方式：按首先触发的信号标记失败轨迹，区分流程错误（调用受阻、循环、步数耗尽）与内容错误（交付了质量不佳的计划）。框架进化修复前者，其诱导的行为可训练进权重，而内容错误是权重训练要解决的。在 DeepPlanning 上，自进化框架使 Qwen3.5-4B 留出得分从 0.16 提高到 0.30，Qwen3.5-9B 从 0.32 提高到 0.44；4B 留出交付率从 55% 到 90%，内容错误留给权重解决。基于进化框架轨迹训练的 LoRA 适配器将收益内化：在原框架下，两种规模均增加 0.13 的留出得分；4B 上与框架叠加使留出得分超过两倍，9B 上单用适配器就匹配完整进化方案，并将内容失败比例从四分之一降至二十分之一。用答案打乱轨迹训练的安慰剂适配器低于基础模型。闭环迁移至 WebArena-Lite，在 117 个未见任务上提高 0.09；该任务的收益来自模型所见信息，适配器没有额外帮助。结果给出两次“先诊断、后干预”的规则：先据失败构成在框架与权重之间选择，再据被接纳编辑改变了什么，决定内化哪些收益。得分是对照新锚点的四次轨迹均值，除特别标注外在同夜测量，覆盖六个系列的八个模型和两个基准。
2610.11655.title: Harness Evolution Hits a Ceiling: When Weight Training Should Begin
2610.11655.authors: Yuan Tian, Bing Hu, Hao Wang, Binghang Lu, Fang Wu
2610.11655.categories: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.11655.affiliation: Independent Researchers / UC Berkeley / Purdue University / Stanford University

2610.10611.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems can improve by searching longer, receiving additional support, or modifying how they propose and verify outputs. A performance score does not distinguish these mechanisms. We compare these changes through bounded verification with hidden terminal randomness. A stage specifies admissible transcripts, polynomial bounds, an alternating verification protocol, and a terminal checker. Its native reach uses default support; its closure frontier permits all support already admitted by the interface. Under a uniform pointwise probability gap and task-relative soundness, these are well-defined languages. We prove that independent majority amplification preserves both languages, whereas existential acceptance over random tapes can admit incorrect outputs. Exact verification is the zero-randomness case, with placement and completeness results. The randomized-verifier classes satisfy $\Sigma_k^{\mathrm{P}}\subseteq\Sigma_k^{\mathrm{RV}}\subseteq\Sigma_{k+1}^{\mathrm{P}}$; strict enlargement and depth separation require explicit complexity assumptions, while $\mathrm{BPP}=\mathrm{P}$ yields exact companions with the same frontiers. Representation analysis separates invariant acceptance from core-versus-support labels that can change under refactoring. For recursive self-improvement, uniformly bounded self-modification under a common sound interpreter and fixed verification protocol remains within the same verification class. A separate conditional-error budget controls false selection across adaptively chosen candidates. A quota-enforced XOR-synthesis family separates unbounded ratios of search success from changes in the accepted languages; exact and probabilistic audits check the resulting evidence requirements. The framework ties self-improvement claims to obligations on correctness, admissible evidence, verification resources, and selection error.
2610.10611.image_note: Figure 1, PDF page 2; crop of the original PDF
2610.10611.update_target: 自改进声明的形式化验证接口与资源边界
2610.10611.mechanism_zh: 区分默认支持下的可达范围与接口已允许支持的闭包前沿，给出有界随机验证和自适应候选选择错误预算。
2610.10611.result_zh: 论文证明共同可靠解释器与固定验证协议下，一致有界的自修改仍属于相同验证类；更强分离依赖明确复杂性假设。
2610.10611.boundary_zh: 这是带条件的理论结论；不能简化成“RSI 不可能”或“所有自修改都不增加能力”。
2610.10611.abstract_zh: 智能体 AI 可以通过更长搜索、获得额外支持，或修改提出和验证输出的方式来改进，但性能得分无法区分这些机制。我们用带隐藏末端随机性的有界验证比较这些变化。一个阶段规定允许的交互记录、多项式界、交替验证协议与末端检查器；其原生可达范围使用默认支持，闭包前沿则允许接口已准许的所有支持。在统一的逐点概率间隔和相对任务的可靠性下，它们构成良定义语言。我们证明，独立多数表决放大保留两种语言，而对随机带作存在量化的接纳可能容许错误输出。精确验证是零随机性的情形，并有归属与完备性结果。随机验证器类别满足 $Sigma_k^{mathrm{P}}subseteqSigma_k^{mathrm{RV}}subseteqSigma_{k+1}^{mathrm{P}}$；严格扩大和深度分离需要明确复杂性假设，而 $mathrm{BPP}=mathrm{P}$ 会产生具有相同前沿的精确对应物。表示分析将不变的接纳行为与可能随重构变化的核心/支持标签分离。对于递归自改进，在共同可靠解释器和固定验证协议下，一致有界的自修改仍位于相同验证类别。另一个条件错误预算控制对自适应选择候选的错误筛选。一个强制配额的 XOR 合成族，将搜索成功的无界比值与被接纳语言的变化区分开；精确和概率审计检验相应证据要求。该框架把自改进声明与正确性、可采纳证据、验证资源及选择错误的义务联系起来。
2610.10611.title: Verification and Self-Improvement in Agentic AI: Foundations and Limits

2610.11803.abstract_en: Self-improving learning systems adapt data selection, optimization, and auxiliary symbolic components, inducing nonstationary objectives outside standard learning assumptions. We introduce \textsc{PRAXIS}, a co-evolutionary framework that models generators, learners, and symbolic archives as interacting dynamical processes. We prove that KL-constrained generator updates and controlled archive-weight movement bound one-step objective drift, that archive updates suppress a program relative to any fixed comparator with a persistent cumulative utility advantage under sub-Gaussian noise, and that stochastic gradient descent achieves an average-stationarity guarantee whose degradation is governed by cumulative objective drift. Experiments across visual robustness, relational graph reasoning, and algorithmic graph reasoning exhibit generator stabilization, decreasing learner loss, and archive concentration consistent with these theoretical mechanisms.
2610.11803.image_note: Figure 2, PDF page 9; crop of the original PDF
2610.11803.update_target: 生成器、学习器和符号档案的共同学习动态
2610.11803.mechanism_zh: 用 KL 约束生成器更新并控制档案权重变化，限制单步目标漂移，分析档案选择与 SGD 的平均平稳性。
2610.11803.result_zh: 视觉鲁棒性、关系图及算法图推理实验呈现与理论机制一致的生成器稳定、损失下降和档案集中。
2610.11803.boundary_zh: 理论保证受噪声和漂移等假设约束；HTML 作者区有模板残留，本期作者与机构以 PDF 首页为准。
2610.11803.abstract_zh: 自改进学习系统会适应数据选择、优化方式及辅助符号组件，从而产生超出标准学习假设的非平稳目标。我们提出共同进化框架 PRAXIS，将生成器、学习器和符号档案建模为相互作用的动态过程。我们证明，KL 约束的生成器更新与受控的档案权重移动能够限制单步目标漂移；在次高斯噪声下，相对于任何持续具有累计效用优势的固定比较程序，档案更新会抑制较差程序；随机梯度下降具有平均平稳性保证，其退化由累计目标漂移控制。视觉鲁棒性、关系图推理和算法图推理实验显示生成器稳定、学习器损失下降及档案集中，这些现象与理论机制一致。
2610.11803.title: PRAXIS: Learning Dynamics of Self-Improving Models with Symbolic Archives

2610.12190.abstract_en: As claims about recursive self-improvement (RSI) and artificial general intelligence (AGI) proliferate, we ask a simple question: do frontier AI models have a sense of data, i.e., can they reliably select the right data for training? We introduce DataSense-Bench to study this capability through the fundamental problem of data selection and performance forecasting in machine learning. We ask AI agents to select and rank candidate training subsets that can be used to fine-tune a small LLM model. Agents are allowed to inspect the data, write and execute analysis code, and run model forward passes, but can not train the model or access the actual evaluation tasks. We then fine-tune the base model on each selected subset and evaluate its post-training performance under a standardized protocol. We instantiate the benchmark in terminal problem solving and tool use, selecting trajectories from OpenThoughts-Agent and EnvScaler and evaluating on TBLite and BFCL, respectively. We then evaluate the agents along two complementary dimensions: the post-training performance of the top-ranked subset, reflecting the ability to identify high-value training data, and ranking accuracy, reflecting the ability to predict the relative performance of the selected subsets. In our experiments, selection gains over random selection are limited; agents do not reliably rank their selected groups, and ranking ability does not hold consistently across tasks: Astra identifies the best group in all three tool-use runs but in only one of three terminal runs. Analysis of execution traces on both tasks shows that agents often use similar data signals while interpreting their training value differently.
2610.12190.update_target: 科研 Agent 的数据选择和训练结果预测能力
2610.12190.mechanism_zh: Agent 可检查数据、写分析代码及运行前向传播，但不能训练或查看真实评估题；后续统一微调验证其排序。
2610.12190.result_zh: 两类任务中，相对随机选择收益有限；Astra 在三次工具使用运行中均找出最佳组，在三次终端运行中仅一次。
2610.12190.boundary_zh: 这是对 RSI 关键能力的评测及负面证据，不是已实现递归自改进的系统。
2610.12190.abstract_zh: 随着递归自我改进（RSI）和通用人工智能（AGI）的声明增多，我们提出一个简单问题：前沿 AI 模型是否具有数据判断力，即能否可靠地选择正确训练数据？我们提出 DataSense-Bench，通过机器学习中的基础问题——数据选择与性能预测——研究这一能力。我们让 AI 智能体选择并排序可用于微调小型 LLM 的候选训练子集。智能体可以检查数据、编写和执行分析代码、运行模型前向传播，但不能训练模型，也不能访问实际评估任务。随后，我们用每个所选子集微调基础模型，并按标准化协议评估后训练表现。基准实例化于终端问题求解和工具使用，分别从 OpenThoughts-Agent 和 EnvScaler 选择轨迹，并在 TBLite 和 BFCL 上评估。我们从两个互补维度评估智能体：排名最高子集的后训练表现，反映识别高价值数据的能力；以及排序准确性，反映预测所选子集相对表现的能力。实验中，相对随机选择的收益有限；智能体不能可靠排序自己选择的组，且排序能力不能跨任务稳定保持：Astra 在三次工具使用运行中均找到最佳组，但三次终端运行中仅一次。两项任务的执行轨迹分析显示，智能体通常采用相似数据信号，却对其训练价值作出不同解释。
2610.12190.title: DataSense-Bench: The First Step Toward an AI Scientist
2610.12190.authors: Yudi Zhang, Mingyu Cao, Lu Yin, Mykola Pechenizkiy, Shiwei Liu
2610.12190.affiliation: Eindhoven University of Technology / University of Surrey / ELLIS Institute Tübingen / Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems / Tübingen AI Center

2610.10619.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly reshaping software engineering, accompanied by an explosion of new code benchmarks. Yet nearly all existing benchmarks still rely on the same decades-old criterion: a solution is correct if it passes a fixed set of unit tests. Such tests are often insufficient: they check only part of what the task requires, so agents can reward hack them or silently miss required behavior while still passing every test. As a result, higher benchmark scores may partly reflect better adaptation to the evaluator rather than better problem solving. Existing works focus on static test augmentation: they strengthen each task's tests once, before any trial is seen, and thus overlook how real trials actually fail. We introduce TestJack, a scalable framework for evaluating patches beyond fixed tests. For each trial, TestJack generates tests targeting prompt requirements the patch may violate, retains only tests passed by the ground-truth patch, and re-examines any trial failures. Each confirmed failure is thus supported by a replayable test. To reduce evaluation cost, we also introduce a lightweight variant which audits a random sample of trials in depth and reuses the resulting tests across all trials for the same task. Across 6 frontier model backends and 5 benchmarks such as DeepSWE and SWE Marathon, we find that about 34.4% of the model trials currently judged correct violate the task requirements, lowering the overall resolution rate from 50.6% to 33.2%. Our results reveal a fundamental limitation of current coding-agent evaluation: as LLMs become better at optimizing against fixed evaluators, those evaluators themselves must become more adaptive.
2610.10619.update_target: 根据候选补丁失败而演化的评估测试
2610.10619.mechanism_zh: 针对补丁可能违反的需求生成测试，保留标准补丁能通过的测试并复核候选失败；轻量变体复用同题审计结果。
2610.10619.result_zh: 六个模型后端、五个基准中，原判正确的试验约 34.4% 违反需求，总解决率从 50.6% 调整为 33.2%。
2610.10619.boundary_zh: 该发现提醒审计自改进分数的真实性；不能仅因测试增加就断言模型本身变差。
2610.10619.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体正在迅速改变软件工程，新的代码基准也大量出现。但几乎所有基准仍依赖几十年来相同的标准：通过固定单元测试就算正确。此类测试往往不足，只检查部分任务要求，智能体可以利用奖励漏洞，或遗漏所需行为却仍通过所有测试。因此，更高基准得分可能部分反映对评估器的更好适应，而非更强的问题求解。已有工作关注静态测试增强，在看到任何试验前一次性加强每题测试，因此忽略真实试验如何失败。我们提出 TestJack，一个超越固定测试评估补丁的可扩展框架。对于每次试验，TestJack 针对补丁可能违反的提示要求生成测试，只保留标准答案补丁能通过的测试，并重新检查候选失败。每个确认的失败因此都有可重放测试支撑。为降低成本，我们还提出轻量变体：深入审计随机抽取的试验，并把产生的测试复用于同一任务的全部试验。在六个前沿模型后端及 DeepSWE、SWE Marathon 等五个基准上，我们发现目前被判为正确的模型试验约有 34.4% 违反任务要求，使总体解决率从 50.6% 降至 33.2%。这揭示了当前编程智能体评估的根本局限：当 LLM 更善于针对固定评估器优化时，评估器本身也必须更具适应性。
2610.10619.title: TestJack: Should you trust the results in coding benchmarks? Agentic Coding Benchmarks Auditing via Evaluator Evolution
2610.10619.authors: Shuangjie Yao, Hao Wang, Koushik Sen, Simin Chen, Baishakhi Ray, Dawn Song
2610.10619.affiliation: Columbia University / UC Berkeley / George Mason University

2610.12289.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) coding agents have advanced test generation across diverse programming tasks. However, the common practice of evaluating tests against a single reference solution overlooks alternative valid implementations and can overstate test quality. We introduce TestPrism, comprising 300 test tasks from 17 sources and 3000 candidate implementations, evenly split between valid and invalid solutions. Its primary metric, Joint Success Function, requires the generated tests to fail on the initial program state, accept every valid candidate, and reject every invalid candidate. Across fourteen baseline coding agent configurations, Joint Success Function reaches only 28.00%, whereas single reference success reaches 59.67%. Our analysis reveals missed behaviors, unsupported assertions, and faulty test construction. To address these weaknesses, we introduce TestHelix, which combines heterogeneous synthesis of test and repair pairs with peer cross validation and recursive self improvement (RSI). Across two models, TestHelix improves Joint Success Function by 8.67 to 9.00 percentage points over the native harness comparators in the TestHelix evaluation
2610.12289.update_target: 测试生成与修复对的闭环，以及多参考正确性评测
2610.12289.mechanism_zh: Joint Success Function 要求初始状态失败、所有合法实现通过、所有非法实现被拒；TestHelix 加入异构生成、交叉验证与 RSI。
2610.12289.result_zh: 300 题、17 个来源、3,000 个候选实现；十四种配置的联合成功率仅 28.00%，单参考成功率为 59.67%。
2610.12289.boundary_zh: 测试只接受一份参考实现可能误杀其他正确解；需在独立多实现集上验证自进化测试。
2610.12289.abstract_zh: LLM 编程智能体推动了多类编程任务的测试生成。但用单一参考解评估测试的常见做法，忽略其他合法实现，可能高估测试质量。我们提出 TestPrism，包含来自 17 个来源的 300 项测试任务和 3,000 个候选实现，其中合法与非法实现各占一半。主指标 Joint Success Function 要求生成测试在初始程序状态失败、接受每个合法候选，并拒绝每个非法候选。在十四种基线编程智能体配置中，该联合成功率仅为 28.00%，而单参考成功率达到 59.67%。分析揭示了遗漏行为、无依据断言和错误测试构造。为解决这些弱点，我们提出 TestHelix，将测试与修复对的异构合成、同行交叉验证和递归自我改进（RSI）结合。在两个模型上，TestHelix 在自身评估中，相比原生运行框架比较对象，将 Joint Success Function 提高 8.67–9.00 个百分点。
2610.12289.title: TestPrism: Rethinking Test Evaluation Beyond a Single Reference

2610.12341.abstract_en: Adversarial games have driven advances from heuristic search to reinforcement learning, yet learning and adapting strategies from limited samples remain challenging. AI agents offer an alternative by turning game experience into revisions of executable policies. Building on heuristic learning (HL), we formalize Adversarial Heuristic Learning (AHL), a paradigm that uses AI agents as learning engines to refine game policies and supporting software while keeping model weights fixed. We introduce AAArena, a benchmark comprising 12 authentic adversarial games and 1,920 archived human programs, with an evaluation protocol modeled on real-world game competitions. Agents interpret rules, choose opponents, analyze replays, and revise game agents to achieve their highest ranking within fixed match and evaluation budgets. We evaluate \val{completedmodels} model and harness configurations: Opus5.5 with Claude Code earns 6 gold medals, while no evaluated configuration tops the remaining 6 human ladders. Performance is generally weaker in games with more complex rule specifications. Further experiments show that opponent selection and dense feedback support policy improvement, and that agents learn from both on-policy replays of their own matches and off-policy replays of other players' matches. These results highlight HL's potential in adversarial games and identify persistent challenges in game understanding, strategy implementation, and long-horizon policy development.

2610.12341.abstract_zh: 对抗游戏推动了从启发式搜索到强化学习的进展，但从有限样本中学习和适应策略仍有挑战。AI 智能体提供了另一条路径：把游戏经验转化为可执行策略修订。在启发式学习（HL）基础上，我们形式化对抗启发式学习（AHL）：以 AI 智能体作为学习引擎，在模型权重固定时细化游戏策略及配套软件。我们提出 AAArena，包含 12 个真实对抗游戏和 1,920 份存档人类程序，评估协议仿照现实游戏竞赛。在固定对局和评估预算内，智能体理解规则、选择对手、分析重放并修订游戏程序，争取最高排名。我们评估了 al{completedmodels} 个模型与运行框架配置［原摘要的此宏未展开，数量未给出］：Opus5.5 配合 Claude Code 获得六枚金牌，但没有任何被评估配置在剩余六个人类排行榜登顶。规则说明越复杂的游戏，表现通常越弱。进一步实验表明，对手选择和稠密反馈支持策略改进；智能体既从自己的 on-policy 对局重放，也从其他玩家的 off-policy 重放中学习。这些结果展示 HL 在对抗游戏中的潜力，也揭示游戏理解、策略实现和长期策略开发方面的持续挑战。

2610.10629.abstract_en: Self-improving LLM agents can adapt a credit pipeline to a changed rule, but an agent that rewrites itself destroys the artefact a supervisor reviews: a named change, a recorded test, an approval. We argue that self-evolution is reviewable only if it is confined to the runtime harness (instruction text, tool-call logic and primitive composition) while model weights stay fixed, so that every adaptation is a diff with a cause and a test attached. We give a dual-loop engine built on that bound, with one admission gate that writes a hash-chained record before deployment, and we measure the gate in simulation, with a simulated agent and a seeded-search proposer rather than language models. Across three families of supervisory re-interpretation at three severities, 10 seeds each, the gated loop admitted 144 of 7,449 candidate changes, none of which worsened error on held-out history, and restored the false-positive rate to the oracle level without raising missed flags in every low- and mid-severity cell. With the gate replaced by the check an unbounded system applies (fewer errors visible in recent traces), the same loops admitted 309 harmful changes and left missed flags above 10% in 49 of 90 runs: false positives fell because the screen was loosened. Evaluated on pre-shift labels, the gate rejected every candidate, so a re-interpretation must be encoded as a rule that relabels history. Parametric and scope shifts were repaired locally, a structural one only by primitive replacement; at the highest structural severity the gate's fixed tolerance blocked the correct replacement in half the seeds. We map the mechanisms to the EU AI Act's provisions for high-risk credit scoring and note that the April 2026 US model-risk guidance excludes agentic AI from its scope.

2610.10629.update_target: 冻结模型设定下的运行框架与部署准入门
2610.10629.mechanism_zh: 双循环改动指令、工具调用和原语组合；准入前写哈希链记录，并用重新标注的历史和留出历史评估。
2610.10629.result_zh: 模拟 Agent 与 seeded-search 提议器实验中，7,449 个候选仅接纳 144 个，均未增加留出历史错误；无门控对照接纳 309 个有害修改。
2610.10629.boundary_zh: 作者明确未用 LLM 做该实验，属于模拟证据；最高强度结构变化中固定容差也会阻挡正确修复。
2610.10629.abstract_zh: 自改进 LLM 智能体能够让信贷流程适应规则变化，但自行重写的智能体会破坏监督者审核的对象：具名修改、记录的测试及批准。我们认为，只有将自进化限制于运行框架——指令文本、工具调用逻辑和原语组合——同时固定模型权重，每次适应成为带原因与测试的差异，才可被审查。基于此边界，我们给出带一个准入门的双循环引擎，在部署前写入哈希链记录，并在模拟中测量该门；实验使用模拟智能体和带种子搜索提议器，而非语言模型。在三类监督规则重新解释、三个强度等级、每格十个随机种子中，门控闭环从 7,449 个候选修改接纳 144 个，没有一个恶化留出历史错误；在所有低、中强度条件下，不增加漏报就将假阳性率恢复至预言机水平。若把准入门换为无约束系统使用的检查方式——近期轨迹可见错误更少——相同闭环会接纳 309 个有害修改，并在 90 次运行中的 49 次中使漏报率保持在 10% 以上：假阳性下降只是因为筛查放松。若仍用变化前标签评估，准入门会拒绝全部候选，因此重新解释必须编码成能重标历史的规则。参数和范围变化可局部修复，结构变化只能替换原语；最高强度结构变化时，门的固定容差在一半种子中阻止了正确替换。我们将机制对应到欧盟 AI Act 对高风险信贷评分的规定，并指出 2026 年 4 月美国模型风险指南将智能体 AI 排除在范围之外。
2610.10629.title: The Harness as the Only Mutable Surface: Compliance-Bounded Self-Evolution of LLM Agents in Credit Pipelines, with a Measured Admission Gate
